lessons.title_am: ሰው ፊት መውጣት፦ ቡና፣ ሰርግ፣ ቤተክርስቲያንና መስጊድ
lessons.title_en: Going out: coffee, weddings, church and mosque
lessons.script_am: ልጅዎን ይዞ መውጣት ይቻላል፤ በዝግጅት ይቀላል። ከመሄድዎ በፊት ስለ ቦታው በቀላል ቃላት ይንገሩት ወይም ፎቶ ያሳዩት፦ «ወደ አክስትህ ቤት ቡና እንሄዳለን፣ ብዙ ሰው አለ።» የሚወደውን ዕቃ፣ መክሰስና ውሃ ይያዙ። ብዙ ሰው የሌለበትን ሰዓት ይምረጡ፤ ለምሳሌ ሰርግ ላይ ከፍተኛ ሙዚቃ ከመጀመሩ በፊት ይድረሱ፣ ቀድመውም ይውጡ። ቀድመው ጸጥ ያለ ጥግ ይፈልጉ። በቤተክርስቲያን ወይም በመስጊድ ጸጥ ያለ ሰዓት ይምረጡ፣ በር አጠገብ ይቀመጡ። ለአዘጋጁ ወይም ለቅርብ ሰው አስቀድመው ይንገሩ። ጫጫታ ከበዛበት የጆሮ መሸፈኛ ወይም ኮፍያ ይረዳል። ለአጭር ጊዜ ይጀምሩ፦ 15 ደቂቃ እንኳን ስኬት ነው። ቁጣ ቢመጣ «አሁን እርዳኝ» የሚለውን «ሰው ፊት ነን» ይጫኑ።
lessons.script_en: You can go out with your child; preparation makes it easier. Before you go, tell him about the place in simple words or show a photo: "We're going to your aunt's for coffee; there will be many people." Bring a favourite object, a snack and water. Choose a less crowded time; at a wedding, for example, arrive before the loud music starts and leave early. Find a quiet corner in advance. At church or mosque, choose a quiet time and sit near the door. Tell the host or a close person beforehand. If it's noisy, ear defenders or a hat help. Start short: even 15 minutes is a success. If a meltdown comes, open Help now and choose "We're in public".

pictures.en: a coffee ceremony, the child in a corner
church and mosque, near the door

key_points.en: Prepare him ahead with words or a photo.
Choose a quiet time and corner.

key_points.am: በአጭር ጊዜ ይጀምሩ፤ 15 ደቂቃም ስኬት ነው።
key_points.en: Start short; 15 minutes is a success.

lessons.try_am: ቀጣዩ የቤተሰብ ዝግጅት ከመድረሱ በፊት ለ{name} የቦታውን ፎቶ ያሳዩት ወይም ስለ ቦታው ይንገሩት።
lessons.try_en: Before the next family event, show {name} a photo of the place or tell him about it.

lessons.title_en: Inside the family: blame, disagreement and fathers
lessons.script_am: ጫናው በቤተሰብ ውስጥ ጭቅጭቅ ሊፈጥር ይችላል። አንዳንድ ዘመዶች እናቱን ይወቅሳሉ፤ አንዳንዴ ባልና ሚስት ስለ ህክምና አይስማሙም። እኔ በማያቸው ቤተሰቦች ከአስር አባቶች አንዱ ያህሉ ብቻ በንቃት ይሳተፋል፤ ብዙ ጊዜ እናት ብቻዋን ትሸከማለች። አባቶች፦ የእርስዎ ተሳትፎ ለልጁም ለእናቱም ትልቅ ነው። በሳምንት አንድ ስራ ይውሰዱ፦ ማታ ማስተኛት፣ ቅዳሜ ጠዋት መጫወት፣ ወደ ቀጠሮ አብሮ መሄድ። ለሁላችሁም፦ የሚወቅስ ሰው ካለ፣ «የማንም ጥፋት አይደለም» የሚለውን ትምህርት አብራችሁ ያዳምጡ። በአንድ ዕቅድ ላይ ይስማሙ፦ ሁሉም ሰው አንድ ዓይነት ቃል፣ አንድ ዓይነት ልማድ፣ እና ቅጣት የሌለበት መንገድ። አያቶች የሚያግዙ ከሆነ ለእነሱ የተዘጋጀውን ኮርስ ያጋሩ። አለመስማማቱ ከበረታ የቤተሰብ አማካሪ ወይም የሚያምኑት የሃይማኖት አባት ሊረዳ ይችላል።
lessons.script_en: The pressure can cause arguments in the family. Some relatives blame the mother; sometimes husband and wife disagree about treatment. In the families I see, only about one in ten fathers is actively involved; often the mother carries it alone. Fathers: your involvement means a lot to the child and to his mother. Take one job a week: putting him to bed, playing on Saturday morning, going to appointments together. For all of you: if someone blames, listen to the "nobody's fault" lesson together. Agree on one plan: everyone uses the same words, the same routine, and a way without punishment. If grandparents help, share the course made for them. If disagreement grows, a family counsellor or a religious leader you trust can help.

pictures.en: a father playing with the child
the family listening to the lesson together

pictures.am: አንድ ዕቅድ፦ አንድ ወረቀት በብዙ እጆች
pictures.en: one plan: one paper in many hands
a religious leader talking with the family

key_points.en: Fathers: take one job a week.

key_points.am: በአንድ ዕቅድ ይስማሙ፦ አንድ ቃል፣ አንድ ልማድ፣ ቅጣት የለም።
key_points.en: Agree one plan: same words, same routine, no punishment.
When there is blame, listen to the lesson together.

lessons.try_am: ከባለቤትዎ ወይም ከሚያግዝዎ ሰው ጋር አንድ «የቤት ቃል» ይምረጡ፤ ለምሳሌ «ቆይ» ወይም «አልቋል»።
lessons.try_en: Choose one "house word" with your partner or helper, for example "wait" or "finished".

lessons.script_am: የኦቲዝም ልጅ ወንድሞችና እህቶች ብዙ ስሜት ይሰማቸዋል፦ ግራ መጋባት፣ ቅናት፣ መከላከል ወይም ሰዎች መጥፎ ሲናገሩ ኀፍረት። ብዙ ጊዜ ትኩረት እንዳጡ ይሰማቸዋል። በዕድሜያቸው መጠን ሐቀኛ ማብራሪያ ይስጧቸው፦ «ወንድምህ አንጎሉ በተለየ መንገድ ያድጋል። መናገር ይከብደዋል፣ ግን ይወድሃል።» በትምህርት ቤት ልጆች ቢያሾፉባቸው ምን እንደሚሉ ያስለማምዷቸው። ሁሉን ኃላፊነት እንዲሸከሙ አያድርጉ፤ እነሱም ልጆች ናቸው። በሳምንት ጥቂት ጊዜ ከእያንዳንዳቸው ጋር ብቻቸውን ጊዜ ያሳልፉ። ስለ ስሜታቸው ይጠይቋቸው፣ ቢናደዱም ይሰሟቸው። ወንድማቸውን በጨዋታ እንዲረዱ ቀላል ሚና ይስጧቸው፤ ሲያደርጉ ያመስግኗቸው።
lessons.script_en: Brothers and sisters of an autistic child feel many things: confusion, jealousy, protectiveness, or embarrassment when people say bad things. They often feel they have lost attention. Give them honest explanations for their age: "Your brother's brain grows in a different way. Talking is hard for him, but he loves you." Practise with them what to say if children tease them at school. Don't make them carry all the responsibility; they are children too. A few times a week, spend time alone with each of them. Ask about their feelings and listen even if they are angry. Give them a simple role in helping their brother through play, and praise them when they do.

pictures.en: a sister looking after her brother
a parent alone with the older child

key_points.en: Give honest explanations for their age.
They also need time and attention alone.
Don't put the whole load on them.

lessons.try_am: ዛሬ ከ{name} ወንድም ወይም እህት ጋር 10 ደቂቃ ብቻችሁን ያሳልፉ፣ ስለ ቀኑ ይጠይቁት።
lessons.try_en: Spend 10 minutes alone with {name}'s brother or sister today and ask about their day.

courses.for: For families weighing treatments; suggested after course 1
courses.card_am: እምነትዎን ይዘው ትክክለኛ ድጋፍ ማግኘት፤ «እርግጠኛ ፈውስ» ከሚሉ መጠንቀቅ።
courses.card_en: Keeping your faith while getting the right support; being careful of "sure cures".
courses.done_am: ተስፋ ማድረግ ትክክል ነው። ተስፋዎን በልጅዎ የዕለት እድገት ላይ ያድርጉ፤ እያንዳንዷ ትንሽ እርምጃ እውነተኛ ናት።
courses.done_en: Hope is right. Put your hope in your child's daily progress; every small step is real.

lessons.script_am: ብዙ ቤተሰቦች ልጃቸውን ወደ ጸበል፣ ወደ ቤተክርስቲያን፣ ወደ መስጊድ ወይም ወደ ጸሎት ቤት ይወስዳሉ። ይህ ለብዙዎች ተስፋ፣ ሰላምና የማህበረሰብ ድጋፍ ይሰጣል። በአዲስ አበባ በተደረገ ጥናት ከወላጆች ከግማሽ በላይ የሚሆኑት በጸሎት እንደሚጽናኑ ተናግረዋል። እምነትዎ ዋጋ አለው፣ መተው አያስፈልግዎትም። አስፈላጊው ነገር እምነት የህክምናውንና የትምህርቱን ቦታ እንዳይወስድ ነው። ጸልዩ፣ ደግሞም ልጅዎ እንዲገመገም፣ በቤት እንዲለማመድ፣ ትምህርት ቤት እንዲገባ ያድርጉ። ጸበል በምትሄዱበት ጊዜ ልጁ ብዙ ሰው፣ ቀዝቃዛ ውሃና ጫጫታ ሊያስጨንቀው እንደሚችል ያስታውሱ። ጸጥ ያለ ሰዓት ይምረጡ፣ ለካህኑ ወይም ለአገልጋዩ ስለ ልጁ ይንገሩ፣ ልጁ ቢፈራ ውሃውን በቀስታ ያድርጉለት። ብዙ ካህናትና ኢማሞች ቤተሰቦችን ይደግፋሉ፤ ሐኪም እንዲያዩም ያበረታታሉ።
lessons.script_en: Many families take their child to tsebel, church, mosque or a prayer house. For many this brings hope, peace and community support. In a study in Addis Ababa, more than half of parents said prayer comforts them. Your faith has value; you don't need to give it up. What matters is that faith does not take the place of care and school. Pray, and also have your child assessed, practise at home and go to school. When you go to tsebel, remember the crowd, cold water and noise may upset him. Choose a quiet time, tell the priest or servant about your child, and pour the water gently if he is afraid. Many priests and imams support families and encourage them to see a doctor too.

pictures.en: tsebel at a quiet time, water poured gently
a priest and an imam with parents

key_points.en: Your faith has value; you don't need to drop it.
Faith should not replace care and school.

key_points.am: ጸጥ ያለ ሰዓት፣ ለካህኑ ማሳወቅ፣ ውሃ በቀስታ።
key_points.en: A quiet time, tell the priest, water poured gently.

lessons.try_am: በሚቀጥለው የጸሎት ጉብኝት ልጁን እንዴት ምቹ እንደሚያደርጉት አንድ ነገር ያቅዱ።
lessons.try_en: Plan one thing to make the next prayer visit comfortable for your child.

lessons.title_en: When someone promises a sure cure
lessons.script_am: ወላጆች ልጃቸው እንዲሻለው ማንኛውንም ነገር ለመሞከር ዝግጁ ናቸው፤ ይህ ፍቅር ነው። ግን አንዳንድ ሰዎች ይህን ፍቅር ይጠቀሙበታል። እነዚህን አደገኛ ምልክቶች ያስተውሉ፦ «በእርግጠኝነት ይፈውሳል» ማለት፤ ብዙ ገንዘብ በቅድሚያ መጠየቅ፤ «ሐኪሙን አቁሙ» ማለት፤ ሚስጥራዊ መድኃኒት ወይም ዱቄት፤ ልጁን ማሰር፣ መራብ፣ መደብደብ ወይም ለረጅም ጊዜ ብቻውን ማስቀመጥ፤ «ለሁሉም ልጆች ይሰራል» ማለት። ኦቲዝም በሽታ ስላልሆነ ፈውስ የሚባል ነገር የለውም። አንዳንድ «ህክምናዎች» በጣም አደገኛ ናቸው፦ ለምሳሌ ብረትን ከሰውነት ያወጣል የሚባል መድኃኒት ወይም በኬሚካል መጠጣት ልጆችን ገድለዋል። አንድ ሰው እንዲህ ቢል፣ ከመስማማትዎ በፊት ሐኪምዎን ወይም ማዕከልዎን ይጠይቁ። ልጁ ሲታሰር ወይም ሲጎዳ ካዩ ለደህንነቱ ቅድሚያ ይስጡ፣ እርዳታ ይጠይቁ።
lessons.script_en: Parents are ready to try anything to help their child; that is love. But some people take advantage of this love. Watch for these danger signs: saying "this will surely cure him"; asking for a lot of money up front; saying "stop the doctor"; secret medicines or powders; tying, starving, beating, or leaving the child alone for long periods; saying "it works for every child". Because autism is not an illness, there is no such thing as a cure. Some "treatments" are very dangerous: for example, so-called metal-removing medicine or drinking chemicals have killed children. If someone says these things, ask your doctor or center before agreeing. If you see a child tied up or hurt, put his safety first and get help.

pictures.en: a lot of money up front

key_points.am: ኦቲዝም በሽታ ስላልሆነ ፈውስ የለም፤ ድጋፍ ግን አለ።
key_points.en: Autism is not an illness, so there is no cure, but there is support.

key_points.am: አደገኛ ምልክቶች፦ እርግጠኛ ፈውስ፣ ብዙ ገንዘብ፣ «ሐኪሙን አቁሙ»፣ ሚስጥራዊ መድኃኒት።
key_points.en: Danger signs: sure cure, lots of money, "stop the doctor", secret medicine.
Ask your doctor before agreeing.

lessons.try_am: ከሰሙት «ፈውስ» አንዱን ያስታውሱና በእነዚህ አደገኛ ምልክቶች ይፈትሹት።
lessons.try_en: Recall one "cure" you have heard of and check it against these danger signs.

lessons.title_en: Medicine and doctors: when are they needed?
lessons.script_am: ለኦቲዝም ራሱ የሚያድን መድኃኒት የለም። ነገር ግን ሐኪም በብዙ መንገድ ይረዳል። አንደኛ፣ ምርመራና ግምገማ፦ ልጁ ምን እንደሚያስፈልገው ማወቅ። ሁለተኛ፣ ከኦቲዝም ጋር አብረው ሊመጡ የሚችሉ ችግሮችን ማከም፦ የሚጥል በሽታ (ኢፒለፕሲ)፣ የመስማት ችግር፣ የሆድ ድርቀት፣ የጥርስ ህመም፣ ከባድ የእንቅልፍ ችግር ወይም ከፍተኛ ጭንቀት። ሶስተኛ፣ አንዳንድ ጊዜ ባህሪው ልጁን ወይም ሌሎችን በከባድ ሁኔታ ሲጎዳ፣ ሐኪሙ ከሌሎች ድጋፎች ጋር መድኃኒት ሊያዝ ይችላል። ደንቦቹ፦ መድኃኒት በሐኪም ትዕዛዝ ብቻ፤ የተባለውን መጠን ብቻ፤ ከጎረቤት ወይም ከሱቅ መድኃኒት አይግዙ፤ ለውጥ ካዩ ለሐኪሙ ይንገሩ። ቤት ውስጥ የሚደረገው ልምምድ ግን ሁልጊዜ ዋናው ነው።
lessons.script_en: There is no medicine that cures autism itself. But a doctor helps in many ways. First, diagnosis and assessment: knowing what the child needs. Second, treating problems that can come with autism: epilepsy, hearing problems, constipation, tooth pain, severe sleep problems or strong anxiety. Third, sometimes when behaviour seriously harms the child or others, the doctor may prescribe medicine together with other support. The rules: medicine only on a doctor's prescription; only the dose given; don't buy medicine from a neighbour or shop; tell the doctor if you see changes. The practice at home is always the main part.

key_points.en: There is no medicine for autism itself.

key_points.am: ሐኪም ለግምገማና አብረው ለሚመጡ ችግሮች ይረዳል።
key_points.en: Doctors help with assessment and related problems.
Medicine only by prescription and dose.

lessons.try_am: {name} የጆሮ፣ የጥርስ ወይም የሆድ ህመም ምልክት እንዳለበት ያስቡ፤ ካለ ለቀጣዩ ቀጠሮ ይጻፉት።
lessons.try_en: Think whether {name} shows signs of ear, tooth or stomach pain; if so, write it down for the next appointment.

lessons.script_am: ስለዚህ ምን ይረዳል? ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ ቶሎ የሚጀመር፣ ቤተሰብን የሚያሳትፍና በየቀኑ የሚደረግ ድጋፍ ይረዳል። የንግግርና የመግባባት ሕክምና፣ የጨዋታና የባህሪ ድጋፍ፣ የራስን መቻል ስልጠና፣ የወላጅ ስልጠና እንደ ዓለም ጤና ድርጅት ፕሮግራም፣ እና አካታች ትምህርት። አንድን ድጋፍ ሲመርጡ እነዚህን ጥያቄዎች ይጠይቁ፦ ለልጄ ፍላጎት የተስማማ ነው? እኔ በቤት ውስጥ የምቀጥልበትን ያስተምረኛል? ውጤቱን እንዴት እናያለን? ልጁን ያስጨንቀዋል ወይም ይጎዳዋል? ዋጋው ምን ያህል ነው፣ ያለሁበት ቦታ ይገኛል? በቤት ውስጥ የምታደርጉት የ5 ደቂቃ ልምምድ፣ በዚህ መተግበሪያ ያሉት ትምህርቶች፣ ነጻ ናቸው፣ ይሰራሉም።
lessons.script_en: So what helps? Studies show that support which starts early, involves the family and happens every day helps. Speech and communication therapy, play and behaviour support, self-care skills training, parent training such as the World Health Organization programme, and inclusive education. When choosing a support, ask: does it fit my child's needs? Does it teach me something to continue at home? How will we see results? Does it stress or harm my child? What does it cost, and is it available where I live? The 5-minute practice you do at home, the lessons in this app, are free, and they work.

pictures.en: a speech therapist with a child

key_points.am: ቶሎ፣ ቤተሰብን የሚያሳትፍ፣ በየቀኑ የሚደረግ ድጋፍ ይረዳል።
key_points.en: Early, family-involving, daily support helps.
Ask 5 questions before choosing.

key_points.am: በቤት የሚደረግ ልምምድ ነጻና ውጤታማ ነው።
key_points.en: Practice at home is free and effective.

lessons.try_am: አሁን ልጅዎ የሚያገኘውን አንድ ድጋፍ በ5ቱ ጥያቄዎች ይፈትሹት።
lessons.try_en: Check one support your child gets now against the 5 questions.

courses.for: For anyone who cares for the child during the day; parents can send it on Telegram
courses.card_am: ልጁን ቀን ለሚንከባከቡ፦ ጥቂት ቃላት፣ በተግባር ማሳየት፣ አንድ ዓይነት ልማድ።
courses.card_en: For those who care for the child in the day: few words, showing, the same routine.
courses.done_am: እርስዎ ለዚህ ልጅ በጣም አስፈላጊ ሰው ነዎት። ትዕግስትዎና ፍቅርዎ በየቀኑ ያስተምሩታል። እናመሰግናለን።
courses.done_en: You are a very important person for this child. Your patience and love teach him every day. Thank you.

lessons.script_am: ይህን ልጅ ስለሚንከባከቡ እናመሰግናለን። ልጁ ኦቲዝም አለበት። ይህ ማለት አንጎሉ በተለየ መንገድ ያድጋል፤ የማንም ጥፋት፣ እርግማንም አይደለም። ስለዚህ ጥቂት ነገሮች ለእሱ ከባድ ናቸው፦ ብዙ ቃላትን መረዳት፣ ስሜቱን በቃል መግለጽ፣ ድንገተኛ ለውጥና ከፍተኛ ድምፅ። ሲያለቅስ ወይም ሲቆጣ «ተቀማጥሏል» ወይም «ባለጌ ነው» ማለት አይደለም፤ ብዙ ጊዜ «ተቸግሬያለሁ» እያለ ነው። ይህ ልጅ ሶስት ነገሮች በጣም ያስፈልጉታል፦ ተረጋግቶ የሚያናግረው ሰው፣ በየቀኑ ተመሳሳይ የሆነ ቀን፣ እና ጥሩ ሲያደርግ የሚያመሰግነው ሰው። ከወላጆቹ ጋር ይነጋገሩ፦ ምን እንደሚወድ፣ ምን እንደሚያስጨንቀው፣ ቤት ውስጥ የትኞቹን ቃላት እንደሚጠቀሙ ይጠይቁ።
lessons.script_en: Thank you for caring for this child. He has autism. This means his brain grows in a different way; it is nobody's fault and not a curse. So a few things are hard for him: understanding many words, saying his feelings in words, sudden change and loud noise. When he cries or gets angry it does not mean he is spoiled or rude; often he is saying "I am struggling". This child needs three things most: someone who speaks to him calmly, a day that is the same every day, and someone who praises him when he does well. Talk with his parents: ask what he likes, what upsets him, and which words they use at home.

pictures.am: ሶስት ነገሮች፦ የተረጋጋ ድምፅ፣ ሰዓት፣ አውራ ጣት
pictures.en: three things: calm voice, clock, thumbs up
the house helper talking with the mother

key_points.am: የማንም ጥፋት አይደለም፤ ልጁ ባለጌ አይደለም።
key_points.en: It is nobody's fault; the child is not being rude.
A calm voice, the same day, praise.
Talk with his parents.

lessons.try_am: ወላጆቹን ይጠይቁ፦ «የሚወደው ምንድን ነው? የሚያስጨንቀውስ?»
lessons.try_en: Ask his parents: "What does he love? What upsets him?"

lessons.script_am: ብዙ ጊዜ በፍቅር ብዙ እንናገራለን፦ «ና ልጄ፣ ተነስ፣ ምግብህን ብላ፣ ቶሎ በል፣ እናትህ ትመጣለች…» ለዚህ ልጅ ግን ብዙ ቃላት ግራ ያጋቡታል። አንድ ጊዜ አንድ ነገር ብቻ ይናገሩ፦ «ምግብ»፣ «ጫማ»፣ «ተቀመጥ»። ከዚያ በተግባር ያሳዩት፦ ጫማውን ያንሱ፣ ወንበሩን ይጠቁሙ፣ ማንኪያውን ይስጡት። ልጁ እስኪረዳ ይጠብቁ፤ በልብዎ እስከ አስር ይቁጠሩ። ካልገባው በተመሳሳይ ቃል አንድ ጊዜ ይድገሙ፣ እጁን በቀስታ ይምሩት። ሲያደርግ በፈገግታ «ጎበዝ!» ይበሉ። ቤት ውስጥ ወላጆቹ የሚጠቀሙባቸውን ቃላትና ምልክቶች ይጠቀሙ፤ ለምሳሌ «ተጨማሪ» ለማለት ሁለት እጅን ማገናኘት። በቪዲዮው ላይ አንዲት አያት ይህን በምሳ ሰዓት ስታደርግ ይመለከታሉ።
lessons.script_en: Out of love we often say a lot: "Come my child, get up, eat your food, hurry, your mother is coming…" For this child, many words confuse. Say one thing at a time: "Food", "Shoes", "Sit". Then show him: pick up the shoes, point to the chair, give him the spoon. Wait until he understands; count to ten in your head. If he didn't understand, repeat once with the same word and gently guide his hand. When he does it, smile and say "Well done!" Use the words and signs his parents use at home, for example touching both hands together for "more". In the video you will see a grandmother doing this at lunchtime.

pictures.en: a hand picking up the shoes

lessons.video: 1:40 · A grandmother at lunch: one word, show, wait, praise.

key_points.en: One word at a time.
Show him, then wait.
Use the parents' words and signs.

lessons.try_am: ዛሬ አንድ መመሪያ በአንድ ቃልና በተግባር ብቻ ይስጡ።
lessons.try_en: Give one instruction today with just one word and showing.

lessons.title_en: When crying comes: wait, don't give in
lessons.script_am: ልጁ ሲያለቅስ፣ ብዙ ሰው ለማስቆም ብሎ የፈለገውን ወዲያው ይሰጠዋል፤ ስልክ፣ ጣፋጭ ወይም መጫወቻ። ያን ጊዜ ለቅሶው ይቆማል፣ ግን ልጁ «ሳለቅስ አገኛለሁ» ብሎ ይማራል፤ በሚቀጥለው ጊዜ የበለጠ ያለቅሳል። በምትኩ ይህን ያድርጉ፦ ተረጋግተው ይቆዩ፣ ደህንነቱን ያረጋግጡ፣ አጠገቡ ይቆዩ፣ ጥቂት ቃላት ብቻ ይናገሩ፦ «እዚህ ነኝ»። ሲረጋጋ፣ የሚፈልገውን ነገር ትክክል ከሆነ ይስጡት፣ እንዲጠይቅም ያስተምሩት፦ በምልክት ወይም በቃል። አይምቱት፣ አይጩሁበት፣ አያስፈራሩት፦ «ጅብ ይበላሃል» ዓይነት ማስፈራሪያ ፍርሃትን ይጨምራል። ለቅሶው ከበዛ ወይም ራሱን ከጎዳ ወላጆቹን ወዲያው ያሳውቁ። በስልኩ ላይ ያለውን «አሁን እርዳኝ» ቁልፍ መጠቀምም ይችላሉ።
lessons.script_en: When the child cries, many people give him what he wants right away to stop it: a phone, sweets or a toy. The crying stops, but the child learns "when I cry, I get it"; next time he cries more. Instead do this: stay calm, make sure he is safe, stay close, say only a few words: "I'm here." When he is calm, give what he wants if it is fine, and teach him to ask for it, with a sign or a word. Don't hit, shout or frighten him: threats like "the hyena will eat you" increase fear. If crying is a lot or he hurts himself, tell his parents right away. You can also use the "Help now" button on the phone.

pictures.en: a hand giving a phone, crossed out

key_points.en: Don't give in just to stop the crying.
Stay calm, stay close, few words.
Don't hit or threaten; tell the parents if it's a lot.

lessons.try_am: በሚቀጥለው ለቅሶ ጊዜ «እዚህ ነኝ» ብቻ ብለው እስኪረጋጋ ይጠብቁ፣ ከዚያ ብቻ ይስጡት።
lessons.try_en: Next time he cries, just say "I'm here" and wait until he is calm before giving anything.

lessons.script_am: ልጁ በየቀኑ ከብዙ ሰዎች ጋር ይሆናል፦ ወላጆች፣ አያት፣ የቤት ሰራተኛ፣ ወንድሞች። ሁሉም የተለያየ ነገር ሲያደርጉ ልጁ ግራ ይጋባል። አንዱ ለቅሶ ላይ ይሰጠዋል፣ ሌላው ይቆጣል፤ አንዱ «አልቋል» ይላል፣ ሌላው «ጨርሷል»። ስለዚህ ሁላችሁም በአንድ ዕቅድ ተስማሙ። ተመሳሳይ ቃላትና ምልክቶች ይጠቀሙ። የቀኑን ቅደም ተከተል ተመሳሳይ ያድርጉ፦ የምግብ፣ የእንቅልፍ፣ የጨዋታ ሰዓት። ለቅሶ ሲመጣ ሁሉም በአንድ መንገድ ይመልሱ። በቀኑ መጨረሻ ለወላጆቹ አጭር ዜና ይስጡ፦ ምን በላ፣ ምን ያህል ተኛ፣ ምን አስጨነቀው፣ ምን ጥሩ ሰራ። አያቶች ስለ ኦቲዝም የተለየ እምነት ቢኖራቸውም፣ የልጁን ዕቅድ በማክበር ትልቅ እርዳታ ያደርጋሉ። እርስዎም ሲደክምዎ ይናገሩ፤ እረፍት ያስፈልግዎታል።
lessons.script_en: The child is with many people each day: parents, grandparents, a house helper, brothers. When everyone does something different, he gets confused. One gives in when he cries, another scolds; one says "finished", another says "done". So agree on one plan together. Use the same words and signs. Keep the day's order the same: meal, sleep and play times. When crying comes, everyone responds the same way. At the end of the day, give the parents a short update: what he ate, how long he slept, what upset him, what he did well. Even if grandparents hold different beliefs about autism, respecting the child's plan is a great help. And tell someone when you are tired; you need rest too.

key_points.en: Everyone uses the same words and signs.
The same daily order and the same response.
A short update to the parents each evening.

lessons.try_am: ዛሬ ማታ ለወላጆቹ 4 ነገሮችን ይንገሩ፦ ምን በላ፣ እንቅልፍ፣ ምን አስጨነቀው፣ ምን ጥሩ ሰራ።
lessons.try_en: Tonight, tell the parents 4 things: food, sleep, what upset him, what he did well.

courses.title_en: For teachers: including the child in class
courses.for: For teachers, school staff and therapists; parents can share it with the school
courses.card_am: ባለጌ አይደለም፦ አጭር መመሪያ፣ የሥዕል ድጋፍ፣ የተለመደ ልማድ፣ ከቤተሰብ ጋር መስራት።
courses.card_en: He is not being naughty: short instructions, picture support, predictable routines, working with the family.
courses.done_am: ለአንድ ልጅ ክፍሉን ምቹ ሲያደርጉ ለሁሉም ልጆች ምቹ ያደርጉታል። የእርስዎ ትዕግስት የልጁን ዕድል ይቀይራል።
courses.done_en: When you make the class work for one child, you make it work for every child. Your patience changes this child's chances.

lessons.title_en: Not naughty: understanding autism in class
lessons.script_am: መምህራን አንዳንዴ ኦቲዝም ያለበትን ልጅ «ባለጌ»፣ «ሰነፍ»፣ «የተቀማጠለ» ወይም «ሆን ብሎ አይሰማም» ብለው ያስባሉ። ብዙ ጊዜ ግን ልጁ መመሪያውን አልተረዳም፣ ፍላጎቱን መግለጽ አልቻለም፣ ወይም በክፍሉ ጫጫታ፣ ብርሃንና ብዛት ተጨናንቋል። ሊያስተውሏቸው የሚችሉ ነገሮች፦ ስሙ ሲጠራ አለመዞር፣ ዓይን ለዓይን አለመተያየት፣ ለውጥ ሲመጣ መበሳጨት፣ እጅ ማርገብገብ ወይም መወዛወዝ፣ በአንድ ርዕስ ላይ ብቻ ማተኮር። እያንዳንዱ ልጅ የተለየ ነው፤ አንዱ ቁጥር በደንብ ያውቃል፣ ሌላው ስዕል ይወዳል። ኢትዮጵያ አካታች ትምህርትን የሚደግፍ ዕቅድ አላት፤ ልጆች ሁሉ የመማር መብት አላቸው። እርስዎ ልዩ ባለሙያ መሆን አያስፈልግዎትም፤ ጥቂት ቀላል ለውጦች ትልቅ ልዩነት ያመጣሉ።
lessons.script_en: Teachers sometimes think a child with autism is "naughty", "lazy", "spoiled" or "deliberately not listening". But often the child didn't understand the instruction, couldn't express what he needs, or is overwhelmed by the noise, light and crowd in the classroom. Things you may notice: not turning when called, little eye contact, getting upset at change, hand flapping or rocking, focusing on just one topic. Every child is different; one knows numbers well, another loves drawing. Ethiopia has a plan supporting inclusive education; every child has the right to learn. You don't need to be a specialist; a few simple changes make a big difference.

pictures.en: a teacher and child in class
every child has the right to learn

key_points.am: ብዙ ጊዜ አለመረዳት ወይም መጨናነቅ ነው፤ ባለጌነት አይደለም።
key_points.en: Often it is not understanding or overload, not naughtiness.

key_points.am: እያንዳንዱ ልጅ የተለየ ጠንካራ ጎን አለው።
key_points.en: Every child has different strengths.

key_points.am: ጥቂት ቀላል ለውጦች ትልቅ ልዩነት ያመጣሉ።
key_points.en: A few simple changes make a big difference.

lessons.try_am: ልጁ ከመበሳጨቱ በፊት በክፍሉ ምን እንደተከሰተ አንድ ጊዜ ያስተውሉና ይጻፉ።
lessons.try_en: Once today, notice and write down what happened in class just before the child got upset.

lessons.script_am: መምህራን ብዙ ጊዜ «ማይታዘዝ ልጅን እንዴት ማስተማር እችላለሁ?» ብለው ይጠይቃሉ። የእኔ መልስ፦ አጭር መመሪያ፣ የሥዕል ድጋፍ፣ የተለመደ ልማድና ተጨማሪ ጊዜ። መጀመሪያ የልጁን ስም ይጥሩ፣ አጠገቡ ይቁሙ፣ ከዚያ አንድ መመሪያ ይስጡ፦ «ደብተርህን ክፈት»። በተግባር ያሳዩ፦ ደብተሩን ይክፈቱለት ወይም ይጠቁሙ። ለመመለስ ጊዜ ይስጡት፤ እስከ አስር ይቁጠሩ። በሰሌዳው ላይ የቀኑን ቅደም ተከተል በቀላል ሥዕል ይሳሉ፦ ንባብ፣ ሂሳብ፣ እረፍት፣ ምሳ። ለልጁ «መጀመሪያ ስራ፣ ከዚያ እረፍት» የሚል ካርድ ይስጡት። ስራውን በትንንሽ ክፍሎች ይክፈሉ፦ 10 ጥያቄ ሳይሆን 3። ሲሳካለት ወዲያው ያመስግኑት። እነዚህ ዘዴዎች ለሌሎች ልጆችም ይጠቅማሉ።
lessons.script_en: Teachers often ask, "How can I teach a child who doesn't obey?" My answer: short instructions, picture support, predictable routines and extra time. First call the child's name, stand near him, then give one instruction: "Open your notebook." Show it: open the notebook or point to it. Give him time to respond; count to ten. Draw the day's order on the board with simple pictures: reading, maths, break, lunch. Give the child a "first work, then break" card. Break the task into small parts: 3 questions, not 10. Praise him right away when he succeeds. These methods help the other children too.

pictures.en: teacher standing close, calling his name

key_points.en: Name, stand close, one instruction.
Show, give time, break the task down.
A picture schedule and a first-then card.

lessons.try_am: ዛሬ የቀኑን ቅደም ተከተል በ4 ቀላል ሥዕሎች በሰሌዳው ጥግ ላይ ይሳሉ።
lessons.try_en: Draw today's order in 4 simple pictures in the corner of the board.

lessons.script_am: ኦቲዝም ያለባቸው ልጆች የሚቀጥለውን ሲያውቁ ይረጋጋሉ። በየቀኑ ተመሳሳይ መቀመጫ፣ ተመሳሳይ የመግቢያ ልማድ፣ ተመሳሳይ የሰዓት ቅደም ተከተል ይስጡት። ልጁን ከበር፣ ከመስኮትና ከጫጫታ ራቅ ብሎ፣ ወደ እርስዎ ቅርብ ያስቀምጡት። ለውጥ ሲኖር፦ አዲስ መምህር፣ ፈተና፣ የክፍል ለውጥ፣ በዓል፣ አስቀድመው ይንገሩት፣ ቢቻል ቀን በፊት ለወላጆቹም ይንገሩ። ደወሉ፣ የሰልፍ ጫጫታ ወይም ሙዚቃ ቢያስጨንቀው፣ ከሌሎች ቀድሞ ወይም ዘግይቶ እንዲወጣ ይፍቀዱለት። በክፍሉ ውስጥ ጸጥ ያለ ጥግ ያዘጋጁ፦ ልጁ ሲጨናነቅ ጥቂት ደቂቃ የሚያርፍበት፤ ይህ ቅጣት አይደለም፣ ማረፊያ ነው።
lessons.script_en: Autistic children are calmer when they know what comes next. Give him the same seat, the same arrival routine and the same order of lessons every day. Seat him near you, away from the door, window and noise. When there is change, a new teacher, an exam, a room change or a holiday, tell him ahead, and tell his parents a day before if you can. If the bell, the assembly noise or music upsets him, let him leave a little before or after the others. Set up a quiet corner in the classroom where he can rest for a few minutes when overwhelmed; it is not a punishment, it is a resting place.

pictures.en: a fixed seat near the teacher
a calendar with a change marked
the child leaving a little early

key_points.en: A fixed seat and the same order.
Announce change to the child and parents ahead.

key_points.am: ጸጥ ያለ ጥግ ማረፊያ ነው፣ ቅጣት አይደለም።
key_points.en: A quiet corner is rest, not punishment.

lessons.try_am: በክፍልዎ ውስጥ ለጸጥ ያለ ጥግ የሚሆን አንድ ቦታ ይምረጡ።
lessons.try_en: Choose one spot in your classroom for a quiet corner.

lessons.title_en: When a meltdown happens in class
lessons.script_am: በክፍል ውስጥ ቁጣ ቢመጣ መጀመሪያ እርስዎ ይረጋጉ። ሌሎቹን ልጆች በተረጋጋ ድምፅ ወደ ስራቸው ይመልሱ፣ ወይም ከልጁ ራቅ እንዲሉ ያድርጉ። ደህንነቱን ያረጋግጡ፦ ወንበሮችንና ስለታማ ነገሮችን ያርቁ። ጥቂት ቃላት ብቻ ይናገሩ፦ «እዚህ ነኝ»። አይጩሁ፣ አይቅጡ፣ በፊት ለፊት አያዋርዱት፣ አይምቱት። ቢቻል ወደ ጸጥ ያለው ጥግ በቀስታ ይምሩት። ቁጣው ካለፈ በኋላ ውሃ ይስጡት፣ በቀስታ ወደ ስራው ይመልሱት። ለሌሎቹ ልጆች በቀላሉ ያስረዱ፦ «አንዳንዴ ጫጫታ ለእሱ ከባድ ነው። ጸጥ ብለን እንረዳዋለን።» ይህ ደግነትን ያስተምራል። ከዚያ ለወላጆቹ ይንገሩ፦ በፊት ምን ሆነ፣ ምን ረዳ። ቁጣውን በፊት የቀሰቀሰውን ነገር አብራችሁ ይፈልጉ። ልጁ ራሱን ወይም ሌላውን ከጎዳ፣ የትምህርት ቤቱን የደህንነት ደንብ ይከተሉ፣ ወላጆቹን ወዲያው ያሳውቁ።
lessons.script_en: If a meltdown happens in class, calm yourself first. In a calm voice, return the other children to their work, or have them move away from the child. Make sure he is safe: move chairs and sharp things away. Say only a few words: "I'm here." Don't shout, punish, shame him in front of others or hit him. If possible, gently guide him to the quiet corner. When it has passed, give him water and gently bring him back to his work. Explain simply to the other children: "Sometimes noise is hard for him. We help by being quiet." This teaches kindness. Then tell his parents: what happened before, what helped. Look together for the trigger. If the child hurts himself or someone else, follow the school's safety rules and tell the parents right away.

pictures.en: a calm teacher guiding the class

pictures.am: ልጅ በጸጥ ያለ ጥግ ውሃ ሲጠጣ
pictures.en: the child drinking water in the quiet corner

key_points.am: እርስዎ ይረጋጉ፤ ሌሎችን ልጆች ይምሩ፤ ደህንነት።
key_points.en: Stay calm, guide the class, ensure safety.
Don't shout, shame or hit.
Tell the parents and look for the trigger together.

lessons.try_am: «አንዳንዴ ጫጫታ ለእሱ ከባድ ነው» የሚለውን ለክፍሉ ልጆች እንዴት እንደሚያስረዱ ያዘጋጁ።
lessons.try_en: Prepare how you will explain "sometimes noise is hard for him" to the class.

lessons.title_en: Working with the family and the other children
lessons.script_am: ቤተሰብ ልጁን ከማንም በላይ ያውቃል። በዓመቱ መጀመሪያ ከወላጆች ጋር ይነጋገሩ፦ ምን ይወዳል? ምን ያስጨንቀዋል? ሲጨናነቅ ምን ይረዳዋል? በቤት ምን ዓይነት ቃላትና ምልክቶች ይጠቀማሉ? በየሳምንቱ አጭር ማስታወሻ ወይም የስልክ መልዕክት ይለዋወጡ፦ ጥሩ የሆነውንም ይናገሩ፣ ችግሩን ብቻ አይደለም። ከንግግር ቴራፒስት ወይም ከልጁ ማዕከል ጋር ከተገናኙ ተመሳሳይ ዘዴ ይጠቀሙ። ሌሎቹ ልጆችም ይማሩ፦ ተራ በተራ የሚያግዙ «ጓደኞች» ይምረጡ፣ በእረፍት ሰዓት በቀላል ጨዋታ እንዲያሳትፉት ያስተምሯቸው። ሌሎች ወላጆች ቅሬታ ቢያቀርቡ፣ በልጁ ግላዊ መረጃ ሳይናገሩ ስለ አካታችነትና ስለ ትምህርት ቤቱ ዕቅድ ያስረዱ። ልጁን ወደ ቤት አስቀድሞ መመለስ ወይም ከክፍል ማስወጣት የመጨረሻ አማራጭ ይሁን።
lessons.script_en: The family knows the child better than anyone. At the start of the year, talk with the parents: what does he love? What upsets him? What helps when he is overwhelmed? What words and signs do they use at home? Exchange a short note or phone message every week: share what went well, not only problems. If you are in contact with a speech therapist or the child's center, use the same methods. The other children can learn too: choose "buddies" who take turns helping, and teach them to include him in simple games at break. If other parents complain, explain inclusion and the school's plan without sharing the child's private information. Sending the child home early or out of class should be the last option.

pictures.en: a teacher and a parent talking

key_points.am: ከወላጆች ጋር በዓመቱ መጀመሪያና በየሳምንቱ ይነጋገሩ።
key_points.en: Talk with parents at the start of the year and weekly.
Use the same methods as the therapist.

key_points.am: የክፍል ጓደኞችን ያሳትፉ፤ ግላዊ መረጃን ይጠብቁ።
key_points.en: Involve classmates; protect private information.

lessons.try_am: ለልጁ ወላጆች ዛሬ ጥሩ የሆነውን አንድ ነገር የሚገልጽ አጭር መልዕክት ይላኩ።
lessons.try_en: Send the child's parents a short message about one thing that went well today.

right_now.sara_am: ቁጣ የልጅዎ «በጣም ከብዶኛል» የሚልበት መንገድ ነው። አብረን እናሳልፈዋለን።
right_now.sara_en: A meltdown is your child's way of saying "this is too much." We'll get through it together.

steps.do_what_am: ስለታማና ጠንካራ ነገሮችን ያርቁ፤ ሌሎችን ልጆች ያርቁ።
steps.do_what_en: Move sharp and hard things and other children away.

steps.do_what_am: ተረጋግተው ይቀመጡ። አንድ ወይም ሁለት ቃል ብቻ፦ «እዚህ ነኝ»።
steps.do_what_en: Sit calmly. One or two words only: "I'm here."

steps.do_what_am: ቴሌቪዥን ያጥፉ፣ መብራት ይቀንሱ፣ ሰዎችን ያርቁ።
steps.do_what_en: Turn off the TV, dim lights, move people away.
steps.do_am: የሚወደውን ብርድ ልብስ ወይም መጫወቻ ያቅርቡ
steps.do_en: Offer his favourite blanket or toy

steps.do_what_am: ውሃ ይስጡት። «ተረጋጋህ፣ ጎበዝ» ይበሉ። ምክንያቱን በኋላ ይፈልጉ።
steps.do_what_en: Give water. Say "You calmed down, well done." Look for the cause later.

after_am: ውሃ ይስጡት፣ ጸጥ ያለ ቦታ ይቀመጡ
after_en: Gently praise {name} for calming
Give water, sit somewhere quiet
Rest a few minutes yourself
right_now.triggers_am: ድንገተኛ ለውጥ፣ ጫጫታ፣ መጠበቅ፣ የሚፈልገውን ሲከለከል፣ ረሃብና ድካም።
right_now.triggers_en: Sudden change, noise, waiting, being told no, hunger and tiredness.

right_now.tile_en: Cries when told no or when waiting
right_now.sara_am: መጠበቅ ለብዙ ልጆች በጣም ከባድ ነው። ዛሬ የምናስተምረው ትዕግስትን ነው።
right_now.sara_en: Waiting is very hard for many children. What we're teaching today is patience.

steps.do_what_am: «አይሆንም» ካሉ፣ ለቅሶውን ለማስቆም ብቻ ብለው አይለውጡት።
steps.do_what_en: If you said no, don't change it just to stop the crying.
steps.dont_en: Giving in when crying gets louder

steps.do_what_am: «ፈልገህ ነበር፣ አዘንክ» ይበሉ። ብዙ አያብራሩ።
steps.do_what_en: Say "You wanted it. You're sad." Don't explain a lot.
steps.do_en: Get down to his eye level

steps.do_what_am: «መጀመሪያ ጫማ፣ ከዚያ ኳስ»። በጣትዎ ወይም በሥዕል ያሳዩ።
steps.do_what_en: "First shoes, then ball." Show with fingers or a picture.

steps.do_what_am: ትንሽ ሲጠብቅ ወዲያው ይስጡትና «ጠበቅክ፣ ጎበዝ» ይበሉ።
steps.do_what_en: When he waits a little, give it right away and say "You waited, well done."

after_en: Thank yourself for holding firm
Teach {name} to ask with a sign
right_now.triggers_am: የሚወደውን ማቆም፣ ስልክ ሲወሰድ፣ ወረፋ፣ ምግብ ሲዘገይ።
right_now.triggers_en: Stopping something he loves, phone taken away, queues, food coming late.

right_now.sara_am: ብዙ ልጆች በእንቅልፍ ይቸገራሉ። እርስዎም ደክመዋል፤ በቀስታ እንጀምር።
right_now.sara_en: Many children struggle with sleep. You're tired too; let's start gently.

steps.do_what_am: መብራት ይቀንሱ፣ ስክሪን ያጥፉ፣ ጫጫታ ይቀንሱ።
steps.do_what_en: Dim lights, screens off, lower the noise.
steps.dont_en: Giving the phone to make him sleep

steps.do_what_am: ሽንት ቤት፣ ልብስ፣ ውሃ፣ መዝሙር፤ ሁልጊዜ በዚህ ቅደም ተከተል።
steps.do_what_en: Toilet, clothes, water, a song; always in this order.

steps.do_what_am: «የእንቅልፍ ጊዜ ነው» ብቻ ይበሉ። ተቀምጠው በጸጥታ ይቆዩ።
steps.do_what_en: Say only "It's sleep time." Sit quietly nearby.
steps.do_en: Gently rub his back (if he likes it)

steps.do_what_am: ወደ አልጋው በአጭሩ ይመልሱት፤ ተመሳሳይ ቃል።
steps.do_what_en: Take him back to bed briefly, same words.
steps.do_en: Wake him at the same time in the morning

after_am: ቀን ላይ ትንሽ ያርፉ፤ ተራ ይቀያየሩ
after_en: Note what helped tonight
Rest during the day; take turns with another adult
right_now.triggers_am: ቀን ላይ ረጅም እንቅልፍ፣ ማታ ስክሪን፣ ሻይ ወይም ቡና፣ ህመም፣ የመኝታ ሰዓት መለዋወጥ።
right_now.triggers_en: Long day naps, screens at night, tea or coffee, pain, changing bedtimes.

right_now.sara_am: ምግብ ጦርነት መሆን የለበትም። ዛሬ ግቡ ጸጥ ያለ ማዕድ ነው።
right_now.sara_en: Food shouldn't be a battle. Today's goal is a calm mealtime.

steps.do_what_am: ለመብላት አያስገድዱት። ሳህኑን አስቀምጠው አብረው ይቀመጡ።
steps.do_what_en: Don't force him. Put the plate down and sit with him.

steps.do_what_am: የሚበላውን አንድ ምግብ ያስቀምጡ፤ አዲሱን ትንሽ አጠገቡ።
steps.do_what_en: Put one food he eats, with a little of the new one beside it.

steps.do_what_am: ቴሌቪዥን ያጥፉ፣ ተመሳሳይ ወንበርና ሳህን።
steps.do_what_en: TV off, the same chair and plate.

steps.do_what_am: ካልበላ፣ ያለ ቁጣ ያንሱት። በሚቀጥለው ሰዓት እንደገና።
steps.do_what_en: If he doesn't eat, clear it without anger. Try at the next mealtime.

after_am: ክብደቱ ከቀነሰ ወይም ውሃ ካልጠጣ ሐኪም ያማክሩ
after_en: Write down what he ate today
If he loses weight or won't drink, see a doctor
right_now.triggers_am: አዲስ ምግብ፣ የምግቡ ቀለም ወይም ልስላሴ፣ የጥርስ ወይም የሆድ ህመም፣ ብዙ መክሰስ።
right_now.triggers_en: New food, the colour or texture of food, tooth or stomach pain, too many snacks.

right_now.sara_am: ለአንዳንድ ልጆች ድምፅ፣ ብርሃንና ለውጥ ከኛ በላይ ይሰማቸዋል። ወደ ጸጥታ እንውሰደው።
right_now.sara_en: Some children feel sound, light and change much more than we do. Let's take him somewhere quiet.

steps.do_what_am: ከጫጫታው ያርቁት፤ ወደ ሌላ ክፍል ወይም ውጭ።
steps.do_what_en: Take him away from the noise, to another room or outside.

steps.do_what_am: ጠበቅ ያለ እቅፍ (ከወደደ)፣ ብርድ ልብስ፣ በቀስታ መወዛወዝ።
steps.do_what_en: A firm hug (if he likes it), a blanket, gentle rocking.
steps.dont_en: Lots of touch if he dislikes it

steps.do_what_am: «አሁን ቤት፣ ከዚያ ምሳ»። አጭርና ግልጽ።
steps.do_what_en: "Now home, then lunch." Short and clear.

steps.do_what_am: እስኪረጋጋ ይጠብቁ። ከዚያ ቀስ ብለው ይመለሱ።
steps.do_what_en: Wait until he is calm, then return slowly.
steps.do_en: Go back for a short time only

after_am: ምን ድምፅ ወይም ለውጥ እንደሆነ ይጻፉ
after_en: Write down which sound or change it was
Next time, tell him beforehand
right_now.triggers_am: ማይክራፎን፣ ሰርግ፣ ገበያ፣ መኪና ጡሩምባ፣ ጸጉር ማድረቂያ፣ አዲስ ቦታ፣ የቀን ቅደም ተከተል መለወጥ።
right_now.triggers_en: Loudspeakers, weddings, markets, car horns, hair dryers, new places, a changed daily order.

right_now.tile_en: We're in public, people are watching
right_now.sara_am: ሰዎች ሲያዩ ከባድ ነው። ግን አሁን አስፈላጊው ልጅዎ ብቻ ነው፤ እርስዎ መጥፎ ወላጅ አይደሉም።
right_now.sara_en: It's hard when people stare. But right now only your child matters; you are not a bad parent.

steps.do_what_am: የሰዎችን ዓይን ይተዉት። ይተንፍሱ።
steps.do_what_en: Let go of people's eyes. Breathe.
steps.do_en: Turn your face to your child

steps.do_what_am: ከተቻለ ወደ ውጭ፣ መኪና ወይም ጥግ ይውሰዱት።
steps.do_what_en: If you can, take him outside, to the car or a corner.

steps.do_what_am: «ልጄ ኦቲዝም አለበት፤ ደህና ነን፣ እናመሰግናለን።»
steps.do_what_en: "My child has autism. We're okay, thank you."
steps.do_en: Show the Gasha card (if you want)

steps.do_what_am: ሲረጋጋ ቤት መሄድ ምንም ችግር የለውም።
steps.do_what_en: Going home once he's calm is perfectly fine.
steps.dont_en: Deciding never to go out again

after_en: Call one person who supports you
What people said is not your fault
right_now.triggers_am: ሰርግ፣ ቤተክርስቲያን ወይም መስጊድ፣ ገበያ፣ ታክሲ፣ ረጅም መጠበቅ።
right_now.triggers_en: Weddings, church or mosque, markets, taxis, long waits.

right_now.sara_en: Protect your child; try not to panic. Let's go slowly.

steps.do_what_am: ትራስ ወይም እጅዎን በጭንቅላቱና በግድግዳ መሃል ያድርጉ።
steps.do_what_en: Put a pillow or your hand between his head and the wall.

steps.do_what_am: ስለታማ፣ ጠንካራና የሚሰበሩ ነገሮችን ያርቁ።
steps.do_what_en: Move sharp, hard and breakable things away.

steps.do_what_am: ጥቂት ቃላት፦ «እዚህ ነኝ፣ ደህና ነህ»።
steps.do_what_en: Few words: "I'm here, you're safe."

steps.do_what_am: ሲረጋጋ ቁስል ይፈልጉ። ደም ከፈሰሰ ወይም ራሱን ከሳተ 907 ይደውሉ።
steps.do_what_en: When calm, check for injuries. If bleeding or unconscious, call 907.
steps.dont_en: Staying silent if it keeps happening

after_am: ምን እንደተከሰተ ይጻፉ (ሰዓት፣ በፊት የሆነ ነገር)
ተደጋጋሚ ከሆነ በዚህ ሳምንት ሐኪም ወይም ማዕከልዎን ያግኙ
after_en: Write down what happened (time, what came before)
If it repeats, see a doctor or your center this week
Self-injury can be a sign of pain
right_now.triggers_am: ህመም (ጆሮ፣ ጥርስ፣ ሆድ)፣ ንዴት፣ መናገር አለመቻል፣ ድካም።
right_now.triggers_en: Pain (ear, tooth, stomach), frustration, not being able to say what he needs, tiredness.

right_now.sara_am: መምታት ብዙ ጊዜ «አልችልም» ወይም «ተወኝ» የሚልበት መንገድ ነው። መጀመሪያ ሌሎችን እንጠብቅ።
right_now.sara_en: Hitting is often a way of saying "I can't" or "leave me alone." First, let's keep everyone safe.

steps.do_what_am: የተጎዳውን ልጅ ወይም ሰው ያርቁ፤ ያጽናኑት።
steps.do_what_en: Move the hurt child or person away and comfort them.

steps.do_what_am: «መምታት አይሆንም» ብቻ። ረጋ ያለ፣ ጠንካራ ድምፅ።
steps.do_what_en: Only "No hitting." Calm, firm voice.

steps.do_what_am: «ተወኝ ማለት ስትፈልግ፣ እጅህን እንዲህ አንሳ» ብለው ምልክት ያሳዩ።
steps.do_what_en: Show a sign: "When you want to be left alone, raise your hand like this."
steps.do_en: Let him squeeze or hit a pillow

steps.do_what_am: ጨዋታው በእርጋታ እንዲቀጥል ይርዱ፤ ጥሩ ሲጫወት ያመስግኑ።
steps.do_what_en: Help play continue calmly; praise him when he plays gently.
steps.dont_en: Keeping him out of all play for long

after_en: Briefly tell the hurt child's parents
Write down what came before
right_now.triggers_am: መጫወቻ መወሰድ፣ ብዙ ልጆች፣ መነካት፣ መናገር አለመቻል።
right_now.triggers_en: A toy taken away, many children, being touched, not having words.

right_now.tile_am: ከቤት ወጥቶ ሄዷል ወይም ሊሮጥ ነው
right_now.sara_en: Search now. Water and roads first.

steps.do_what_am: በአቅራቢያ ውሃ (ኩሬ፣ ጉድጓድ፣ ወንዝ) እና መንገድ መጀመሪያ ይፈልጉ።
steps.do_what_en: Check nearby water (ponds, wells, rivers) and roads first.

steps.do_what_am: ለጎረቤቶች ፎቶውን ያሳዩ፤ ልብሱን ይግለጹ።
steps.do_what_en: Show neighbours his photo and describe his clothes.

steps.do_what_am: ካልተገኘ ፖሊስ ይደውሉ። ስሙን፣ ዕድሜውን፣ ልብሱን፣ ኦቲዝም እንዳለበት ይንገሩ።
steps.do_what_en: If not found, call the police. Give his name, age, clothes and that he has autism.

steps.do_what_am: ያቅፉት፣ ውሃ ይስጡት፣ ጉዳት ይመልከቱ። አይቅጡት።
steps.do_what_en: Hold him, give water, check for injuries. Don't punish him.
steps.do_en: Fit a high lock on the door

after_am: ስልክ ቁጥርዎን በኪሱ ወይም በአምባር ላይ ያድርጉ
after_en: Keep a recent photo
Put your phone number in his pocket or on a bracelet
right_now.triggers_am: የተከፈተ በር፣ ውሃ ወይም መኪና መውደድ፣ ጫጫታን መሸሽ።
right_now.triggers_en: An open door, loving water or cars, escaping noise.

right_now.sara_am: ፍርሃቱ ለእኛ ትንሽ ቢመስልም ለእሱ እውነት ነው። ደህንነቱን እናሳየው።
right_now.sara_en: His fear may seem small to us, but it is real to him. Let's show him he is safe.

steps.do_what_am: ውሻ፣ ሐኪም መርፌ፣ ጨለማ ወይም ድምፅ፤ በቀስታ ያርቁት።
steps.do_what_en: A dog, a needle, darkness or a sound; gently move him away.

steps.do_what_am: «ደህና ነህ፣ እኔ አለሁ»።
steps.do_what_en: "You're safe, I'm here."

steps.do_what_am: የሚወደውን መጫወቻ፣ ብርድ ልብስ ወይም መዝሙር።
steps.do_what_en: His favourite toy, blanket or song.

steps.title_en: Later, get used to it slowly
steps.do_what_am: በሌላ ቀን ፎቶ ወይም ከሩቅ በማሳየት በትንሹ ይጀምሩ።
steps.do_what_en: Another day, start small with a photo or from a distance.
steps.dont_en: Expecting a lot in one day

after_en: Write down what scared him
Prepare ahead for doctor visits
right_now.triggers_am: ውሾች፣ መርፌ፣ ጸጉር ቤት፣ ጨለማ፣ ነጎድጓድ፣ አዲስ ሰዎች።
right_now.triggers_en: Dogs, needles, barbers, darkness, thunder, new people.

right_now.tile_en: Won't stop or move on (phone, TV, leaving)
right_now.sara_am: ከሚወደው ነገር መለየት ከባድ ነው። ማስጠንቀቂያ መስጠት ብዙ ይረዳል።
right_now.sara_en: Leaving something he loves is hard. A warning helps a lot.

steps.do_what_am: «2 ደቂቃ ቀረ» ይበሉ፤ ጣቶችዎን ያሳዩ።
steps.do_what_en: Say "2 more minutes" and show your fingers.

steps.do_what_am: «መጀመሪያ ገላ፣ ከዚያ ኳስ»። ቀጣዩን የሚወደውን ያሳዩ።
steps.do_what_en: "First bath, then ball." Show the next thing he likes.
steps.do_en: Show what's next in a picture

steps.do_what_am: «ቻው ቴሌቪዥን» እንዲል ወይም እንዲያጠፋው ይፍቀዱ።
steps.do_what_en: Let him say "bye TV" or switch it off himself.

steps.do_what_am: «አቆምክ፣ ጎበዝ!» ወዲያው ቃል የገቡትን ይስጡ።
steps.do_what_en: "You stopped, well done!" Give what you promised right away.
steps.dont_en: Giving it back when crying grows

after_am: የስክሪን ጊዜን በቀን ተመሳሳይ ሰዓት ያድርጉ
after_en: Keep screen time at the same time each day
right_now.triggers_am: ስልክ፣ ቴሌቪዥን፣ ጨዋታ ማቆም፣ ከቤት መውጣት፣ ከማዕከል ወደ ቤት መሄድ።
right_now.triggers_en: Stopping phone, TV or play, leaving home, leaving the center.

right_now.tile_am: ገላ መታጠብ፣ ፀጉር መቆረጥ ወይም ልብስ መልበስ አይፈልግም
right_now.sara_am: ውሃ፣ መቀስና ልብስ ለአንዳንድ ልጆች ህመም ያህል ይሰማቸዋል። ቀስ ብለን አጭር እናድርገው።
right_now.sara_en: Water, scissors and clothes can feel almost painful to some children. Let's keep it slow and short.

steps.do_what_am: ፎጣውን፣ ማበጠሪያውን ወይም ልብሱን አስቀድመው ያሳዩ።
steps.do_what_en: Show the towel, comb or clothes beforehand.

steps.do_what_am: ለብ ያለ ውሃ፣ ለስላሳ ልብስ (ምልክቱ የተቆረጠ)፣ በእጅ የሚሰራ መቀስ።
steps.do_what_en: Lukewarm water, soft clothes with labels cut, hand clippers not electric.
steps.do_en: Pour water slowly with a cup

steps.do_what_am: «እስከ 10 ቆጠርን፣ አለቀ»። አጭር ያድርጉት።
steps.do_what_en: "We counted to 10, finished." Keep it short.

steps.do_what_am: ሲጨርስ የሚወደውን ነገር ይስጡት፤ ያመስግኑት።
steps.do_what_en: When done, give something he loves and praise him.
steps.do_en: Stop when a small part works

after_am: ጸጉር ቤት አስቀድሞ ይጎብኙ፣ ጸጥ ባለ ሰዓት ይሂዱ
after_en: Visit the barber beforehand and go at a quiet time
right_now.triggers_am: ቀዝቃዛ ወይም ሙቅ ውሃ፣ የመቀስ ድምፅ፣ የሚኮሰኩስ ልብስ፣ ጫማ።
right_now.triggers_en: Cold or hot water, the sound of clippers, scratchy clothes, shoes.

right_now.sara_am: አደጋ ይከሰታል፤ የመማር አካል ነው። ያለ ቁጣ እናጽዳው።
right_now.sara_en: Accidents happen; they're part of learning. Let's clean up without anger.

steps.do_what_am: «ምንም አይደለም፣ እናጽዳ» ይበሉ።
steps.do_what_en: Say "It's okay, let's clean up."

steps.do_what_am: በጸጥታ ያጽዱና ልብስ ይቀይሩ። ብዙ አያውሩ።
steps.do_what_en: Clean quietly and change clothes. Don't talk a lot.
steps.dont_en: Talking about it in front of others

steps.do_what_am: ለጥቂት ደቂቃ እንዲቀመጥ ያድርጉ።
steps.do_what_en: Have him sit for a few minutes.

steps.do_what_am: በመጸዳጃ ሲጠቀም ወዲያው ያመስግኑ።
steps.do_what_en: Praise him right away when he uses the toilet.

after_am: የሰዓት ማስታወሻ ይያዙ፤ ብዙ ጊዜ በተመሳሳይ ሰዓት ይሄዳሉ
ህመም ወይም ሆድ ድርቀት ካለ ሐኪም ያማክሩ
after_en: Note the times; children often go at similar times
If there's pain or constipation, see a doctor
right_now.triggers_am: የሆድ ድርቀት፣ የማያውቀው መጸዳጃ፣ ጨለማ፣ የውሃ ድምፅ፣ ጨዋታ ማቆም አለመፈለግ።
right_now.triggers_en: Constipation, an unfamiliar toilet, darkness, the flush sound, not wanting to stop playing.

right_now.tile_en: Seems to be in pain or sick
right_now.sara_am: ብዙ ልጆች ህመማቸውን መናገር አይችሉም፤ በባህሪ ያሳያሉ። እንመልከተው።
right_now.sara_en: Many children can't say they are in pain; they show it through behaviour. Let's check.

steps.do_what_am: ጆሮ መያዝ፣ ጭንቅላት መምታት፣ ሆድ መያዝ፣ አለመብላት፣ ትኩሳት።
steps.do_what_en: Holding ears, hitting his head, holding his stomach, not eating, fever.

steps.do_what_am: «የት ያምሃል?» ብለው የሰውነት ሥዕል ያሳዩ።
steps.do_what_en: Ask "Where does it hurt?" and show a body picture.

steps.do_what_am: ያርፍ፣ ውሃ ይጠጣ፣ ጸጥ ያለ ቦታ።
steps.do_what_en: Let him rest and drink water in a quiet place.

steps.do_what_am: ትኩሳት፣ ማስመለስ፣ ደም ወይም ከፍተኛ ህመም ካለ ወደ ጤና ተቋም ይሂዱ።
steps.do_what_en: With fever, vomiting, blood or severe pain, go to a health facility.
steps.do_en: Tell the doctor what you noticed

after_en: Write what you saw and use "Show the doctor"
right_now.triggers_am: የጆሮ ኢንፌክሽን፣ ጥርስ ማብቀል ወይም ህመም፣ የሆድ ድርቀት፣ ጉንፋን።
right_now.triggers_en: Ear infections, teething or tooth pain, constipation, colds.

right_now.sara_am: አንዳንዴ ልጆች ለማረፍ ይገለላሉ፤ አንዳንዴ ግን ያዝናሉ ወይም ያማቸዋል። በቀስታ እንቅረብ።
right_now.sara_en: Sometimes children withdraw to rest; sometimes they are sad or unwell. Let's come close gently.

steps.do_what_am: ትኩሳት፣ ህመም ወይም ድካም እንዳለ ይመልከቱ።
steps.do_what_en: Check for fever, pain or tiredness.

steps.do_what_am: እሱ የሚያደርገውን በቀስታ ይኮርጁ።
steps.do_what_en: Gently copy what he is doing.

steps.do_what_am: የሚወደውን መዝሙር ወይም መጫወቻ ያቅርቡ፤ ይጠብቁ።
steps.do_what_en: Offer a favourite song or toy, then wait.

steps.do_what_am: ለብዙ ቀናት ከቀጠለ፣ ክህሎቶች ከጠፉ ወይም ካልበላ ባለሙያ ያማክሩ።
steps.do_what_en: If it lasts several days, skills are lost, or he stops eating, see a professional.

after_en: Play together for 5 minutes today
right_now.triggers_am: ድካም፣ ህመም፣ አዲስ ቦታ፣ የቤተሰብ ለውጥ (ሰው መሄድ፣ መዛወር)።
right_now.triggers_en: Tiredness, illness, a new place, family change (someone leaving, moving house).

right_now.tile_en: Fighting with a brother or sister
right_now.sara_am: ሁለቱም ልጆችዎ እርስዎን ይፈልጋሉ። መጀመሪያ እንለያቸው፣ ከዚያ ሁለቱንም እናዳምጥ።
right_now.sara_en: Both your children need you. First separate them, then listen to both.

steps.do_what_am: ለሁለቱም የራሳቸው ቦታ ይስጡ።
steps.do_what_en: Give each one their own space.

steps.do_what_am: የተጎዳውን መጀመሪያ፣ ከዚያ ሌላውን።
steps.do_what_en: The hurt one first, then the other.
steps.do_en: Thank the sibling for their patience

steps.do_what_am: ብዙ ጊዜ መጫወቻ ወይም ቦታ ነው።
steps.do_what_en: Usually it's a toy or space.
steps.dont_en: Always making the sibling give in

steps.do_what_am: ተራ መውሰድ ያለበት ቀላል ጨዋታ፦ ኳስ ማንከባለል።
steps.do_what_en: A simple turn-taking game: rolling a ball.
steps.dont_en: Making the sibling a full-time carer

after_am: ዛሬ ከወንድሙ/እህቱ ጋር ብቻ 10 ደቂቃ ያሳልፉ
after_en: Spend 10 minutes alone with the brother or sister today
right_now.triggers_am: መጫወቻ መጋራት፣ ትኩረት፣ ጫጫታ፣ የቤት ስራ ሰዓት።
right_now.triggers_en: Sharing toys, attention, noise, homework time.

questions.q_en: How do I know if my child has autism?
questions.short_am: በቤት ውስጥ ማረጋገጥ አይቻልም፤ ባለሙያ ነው የሚወስነው።
questions.short_en: You can't confirm it at home; a professional decides.
questions.answer_am: ኦቲዝምን የሚለይ የደም ወይም የራጅ ምርመራ የለም። ባለሙያው ልጁን በመመልከት፣ በመጫወትና እርስዎን በመጠየቅ ነው የሚወስነው። እርስዎ የሚያስተዉሉት ግን በጣም አስፈላጊ ነው፦ ስሙ ሲጠራ አለመዞር፣ የንግግር መዘግየት፣ ዓይን ለዓይን አለመተያየት፣ ተደጋጋሚ እንቅስቃሴ። እነዚህን ይመዝግቡና ለባለሙያው ያሳዩ።
questions.answer_en: There is no blood test or scan for autism. A professional decides by watching your child, playing and asking you questions. What you notice matters a lot: not turning to his name, late speech, little eye contact, repeated movements. Note them and show the professional.
questions.next_step: Signs checklist (5.3) · Lesson 2.2 ምልክቶቹ

questions.q_en: At what age should we get him assessed?
questions.short_am: ስጋት እንዳደረብዎ ወዲያው፤ መጠበቅ አያስፈልግም።
questions.short_en: As soon as you are worried; don't wait.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ ጊዜ ምልክቶች ከ18 ወር እስከ 3 ዓመት ይታያሉ። ግን በማንኛውም ዕድሜ ማስመርመር ይቻላል። «ያድጋል፣ ይለቀዋል» ብሎ መጠበቅ ጠቃሚ ጊዜ ያሳልፋል። ቶሎ ድጋፍ የሚያገኝ ልጅ በብዙ ይጠቀማል።
questions.answer_en: Signs often show between 18 months and 3 years. But assessment is possible at any age. Waiting to "grow out of it" loses valuable time. A child who gets support early benefits a lot.
questions.next_step: Find help (5.1) · What to ask the doctor (5.5)

questions.q_am: የት ሄደን ማስመርመር እንችላለን? ስንትስ ያስከፍላል?
questions.q_en: Where can we get him assessed, and how much does it cost?
questions.short_am: በመንግስት ሆስፒታሎች በዝቅተኛ ክፍያ፣ በግል ማዕከላትም ይቻላል።
questions.short_en: At government hospitals for a low fee, and at private centers.
questions.answer_am: በአዲስ አበባ የየካቲት 12 እና የቅዱስ ጳውሎስ ሆስፒታሎች የሕፃናት አእምሮ ጤና ክሊኒክ አላቸው። ብዙ ጊዜ ከጤና ጣቢያ ሪፈራል ያስፈልጋል፤ ክፍያው ዝቅተኛ ነው፣ የነጻ ህክምና ማስረጃ ካለዎት ይቀራል። የግል ማዕከላትም ግምገማ ይሰጣሉ፤ ዋጋቸው ይለያያል። ከመሄድዎ በፊት ስልክ ደውለው ይጠይቁ።
questions.answer_en: In Addis Ababa, Yekatit 12 and St Paul's hospitals have child mental health clinics. You usually need a referral from a health center; the fee is low, and waived if you have a fee-waiver certificate. Private centers also assess; prices vary. Call before you go.
questions.next_step: Find help (5.1), filter "ሐኪሞች" · What to ask the doctor (5.5)

questions.q_en: The doctor said "he'll grow out of it, wait." Is that right?
questions.short_am: ስጋትዎ ከቀጠለ ሌላ ባለሙያ ማማከር መብትዎ ነው።
questions.short_en: If you're still worried, asking another professional is your right.
questions.answer_am: አንዳንድ ልጆች በእርግጥ ዘግይተው ይናገራሉ። ግን ስሙ ሲጠራ የማይዞር፣ የማይጠቁም ወይም ያወቃቸውን ቃላት የረሳ ልጅ ካለ መጠበቅ የለብዎትም። ሌላ ባለሙያ ይጠይቁ፣ የቀረጹትን ቪዲዮ ያሳዩ። እስከዚያው ቤት ውስጥ መጫወትና መነጋገር ይጀምሩ፤ አይጎዳም፣ ይረዳል።
questions.answer_en: Some children really do talk late. But if he doesn't turn to his name, doesn't point, or has lost words he knew, don't wait. Ask another professional and show your videos. Meanwhile start playing and talking at home; it can't hurt, and it helps.
questions.next_step: Lesson 3.1 ለምን ጨዋታ? · Find help (5.1)

questions.q_en: After the diagnosis says "autism", what do we do?
questions.short_am: በትንሹ ይጀምሩ፦ አንድ ኮርስ፣ አንድ ማዕከል፣ በቀን 5 ደቂቃ።
questions.short_en: Start small: one course, one center, 5 minutes a day.
questions.answer_am: መጀመሪያ ለራስዎ ጊዜ ይስጡ፤ ማዘን የተለመደ ነው። ከዚያ ሦስት ነገሮች፦ በ«የመጀመሪያዎቹ 2 ወራት» ኮርስ ይጀምሩ፣ በአቅራቢያዎ ያለ ማዕከል ይደውሉና የወረፋ ዝርዝር ላይ ይመዝገቡ፣ ቤት ውስጥ በቀን አጭር የጨዋታ ጊዜ ይጀምሩ። ወረፋው ረጅም ቢሆንም በቤት የሚሰሩት ይቆጠራል።
questions.answer_en: First give yourself time; grief is normal. Then three things: start the "First 2 months" course, call a nearby center and join the waiting list, and start a short play time at home each day. Even if the wait is long, what you do at home counts.
questions.next_step: Course 1 የመጀመሪያዎቹ 2 ወራት · Find help (5.1)

questions.q_en: How can we help him at home?
questions.short_am: በየቀኑ አጭር ጨዋታ፣ አጭር ቃላት፣ የተለመደ ልማድ።
questions.short_en: Short play every day, short words, the same routine.
questions.answer_am: ቴራፒ የሚሰጥ ባለሙያ ባይኖርም ብዙ ማድረግ ይችላሉ። በቀን 5 ደቂቃ ፊት ለፊት ተቀምጠው እሱ የሚወደውን ይጫወቱ። አንድ ወይም ሁለት ቃላት ብቻ ይጠቀሙ፣ በተግባር ያሳዩት። የቀኑን ቅደም ተከተል ተመሳሳይ ያድርጉ። ትንሽ ሲሳካለት ወዲያው ያመስግኑት።
questions.answer_en: Even without a therapist you can do a lot. Sit face to face for 5 minutes a day and play what he loves. Use only one or two words and show him. Keep the order of the day the same. Praise him right away when he manages something small.
questions.next_step: Lesson 1.6 በየቀኑ የሚደረጉ ትንንሽ ነገሮች · Course 3 ጨዋታና መቀራረብ

questions.q_en: Is it my fault that my child doesn't talk?
questions.short_am: አይደለም።
questions.short_en: No.
questions.answer_am: ኦቲዝም በወላጆች አስተዳደግ ወይም በኃጢአት አይመጣም። አንጎል በተለየ መንገድ ስለሚያድግ ነው። ራስዎን መውቀስ ልጅዎን አይረዳም። ልጅዎ አሁንም ልጅዎ ነው። ከእርስዎ ጋር በየቀኑ መጫወትና መነጋገር ይረዳዋል።
questions.answer_en: Autism does not come from how parents raise a child, or from sin. It is because the brain develops differently. Blaming yourself does not help your child. Your child is still your child. Playing and talking with you every day helps him.
questions.next_step: Course 4 ንግግርና መግባባት በቤት · Find a speech professional (5.1)

questions.q_en: Is it a curse, the evil eye, or a spirit?
questions.short_am: አይደለም፤ ኦቲዝም የአንጎል እድገት ልዩነት ነው።
questions.short_en: No; autism is a difference in how the brain develops.
questions.answer_am: በአዲስ አበባ በተደረገ ጥናት ብዙ ወላጆች መንፈስ ወይም እርግማን እንደሆነ ይሰሙ ነበር። ይህ እምነት ወላጆችን ያሳፍራል፣ ልጁንም ይደብቃል። ሳይንስ ግን ኦቲዝም በዘረመልና በአንጎል እድገት እንደሚመጣ ያሳያል። በዓለም ዙሪያ በሁሉም ሀገርና ሃይማኖት ይገኛል። መጸለይ ይችላሉ፤ ከጸሎቱ ጋር ልጅዎ የትምህርትና የቴራፒ ድጋፍም ያስፈልገዋል።
questions.answer_en: In a study in Addis Ababa, many parents had heard it was a spirit or a curse. That belief brings shame on parents and makes children hidden. Science shows autism comes from genes and brain development. It is found in every country and every religion. You can pray; alongside prayer, your child also needs learning and therapy support.
questions.next_step: Lesson 2.3 ስለ ምክንያቱ እውነቱ · Lesson 1.4 እምነትና ሕክምና አብረው

questions.q_en: Is it a punishment for our sins?
questions.short_am: አይደለም። ልጅዎ ቅጣት አይደለም።
questions.short_en: No. Your child is not a punishment.
questions.answer_am: ኦቲዝም ከወላጆች ሥራ ወይም ኃጢአት ጋር አይገናኝም። ደጋግ ቤተሰቦችም ኦቲዝም ያለበት ልጅ ይወልዳሉ። ብዙ የሃይማኖት አባቶችም ልጁ ፍቅርና ድጋፍ እንጂ ፍርድ እንደማያስፈልገው ያስተምራሉ።
questions.answer_en: Autism is not linked to what parents did or to sin. Good, faithful families also have children with autism. Many religious leaders also teach that a child needs love and support, not judgment.
questions.next_step: Lesson 1.2 ምርመራው ምን ማለት ነው? · Lesson 8.1 እምነትዎን ይዘው መቀጠል

questions.q_en: Is it because of something I did in pregnancy?
questions.short_am: እርስዎ ያደረጉት ነገር አይደለም።
questions.short_en: It is not something you did.
questions.answer_am: እናቶች ብዙ ጊዜ ራሳቸውን ይወቅሳሉ፦ የበሉት፣ የሰሩት፣ ያዘኑት። ይህ ኦቲዝምን አያመጣም። ተመራማሪዎች እንደ ዘረመል፣ ያለጊዜው መወለድና የወላጆች ዕድሜ ያሉ ነገሮች ዕድሉን እንደሚጨምሩ ይናገራሉ፤ እነዚህም የማንም ጥፋት አይደሉም።
questions.answer_en: Mothers often blame themselves: what they ate, how they worked, how sad they were. These do not cause autism. Researchers say things like genes, being born early and parents' age can raise the chance; none of these is anyone's fault.
questions.next_step: Lesson 2.3 ስለ ምክንያቱ እውነቱ

questions.q_en: The family blames me. Are they right?
questions.short_am: አይደሉም። ወቀሳው የመረጃ እጥረት ነው።
questions.short_en: No. The blame comes from not knowing.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ እናቶች ከባል ቤተሰብ ወቀሳ ይደርስባቸዋል። ኦቲዝም ከአንዳቸውም ወላጅ ብቻ አይመጣም፤ የማንም ጥፋት አይደለም። አጭር መልስ ያዘጋጁ፦ «ሐኪሙ የማንም ጥፋት አይደለም ብሏል። እርዳታችሁን እንፈልጋለን።» ከፈለጉ የ«ኦቲዝም ምንድን ነው?» ትምህርትን በቴሌግራም ይላኩላቸው።
questions.answer_en: Many mothers are blamed by their husband's family. Autism does not come from one parent; it is no one's fault. Prepare a short answer: "The doctor said it is no one's fault. We need your help." If you want, send them the "What is autism?" lesson on Telegram.
questions.next_step: Lesson 1.3 ለቤተሰብ እንዴት እንናገር · Lesson 7.4 በቤተሰብ ውስጥ

questions.q_en: Do vaccines cause it?
questions.short_am: አያመጣም። ልጅዎን ማስከተብዎን ይቀጥሉ።
questions.short_en: No. Keep vaccinating your child.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ ትላልቅ ጥናቶች በሚሊዮኖች ልጆች ላይ ክትባትና ኦቲዝም እንደማይገናኙ አሳይተዋል። ምልክቶቹ ክትባት በሚሰጥበት ዕድሜ አካባቢ ስለሚታዩ ወላጆች ያገናኙታል። ክትባት ልጅዎን ከከባድ በሽታዎች ይጠብቀዋል፤ ወንድሞቹንና እህቶቹንም ያስከትቡ።
questions.answer_en: Many large studies of millions of children show vaccines and autism are not linked. Signs appear around the age vaccines are given, so parents connect them. Vaccines protect your child from serious illness; vaccinate his brothers and sisters too.
questions.next_step: Lesson 2.3 ስለ ምክንያቱ እውነቱ

questions.q_en: Will our child talk? Will he get better?
questions.short_am: ብዙ ልጆች ይሻሻላሉ፤ መግባባት ደግሞ ሁልጊዜ ማደግ ይችላል።
questions.short_en: Many children improve, and communication can always grow.
questions.answer_am: ማንም በእርግጠኝነት መናገር አይችልም፤ እያንዳንዱ ልጅ የተለየ ነው። ብዙ ኦቲዝም ያለባቸው ልጆች ይናገራሉ፣ አንዳንዶቹ ዘግይተው። ቃል የማይጠቀሙ ልጆችም በምልክት፣ በሥዕልና በመሳሪያ መግባባት ይማራሉ። ምልክትና ሥዕል ንግግርን አያስቆሙም፤ ይረዳሉ። ዛሬ የሚጀምሩት ቀላል ልምምድ ልዩነት ያመጣል።
questions.answer_en: No one can say for sure; every child is different. Many children with autism do talk, some later. Children who don't use words also learn to communicate with signs, pictures and devices. Signs and pictures do not stop speech; they help it. Simple practice you start today makes a difference.
questions.next_step: Course 4 ንግግርና መግባባት በቤት · Find a speech professional (5.1)

questions.q_en: If we use signs and pictures, won't it delay his speech?
questions.short_am: አያዘገየውም፤ ብዙ ጊዜ ንግግርን ያበረታታል።
questions.short_en: No; it often encourages speech.
questions.answer_am: ልጅዎ የሚፈልገውን በሥዕል ወይም በምልክት ማሳየት ሲችል ብስጭቱ ይቀንሳል። ምልክቱን ሲያሳይ ቃሉን ሁልጊዜ ጮክ ብለው ይናገሩ፦ «ውሃ»። ብዙ ልጆች ከጊዜ በኋላ ቃሉን ራሳቸው መናገር ይጀምራሉ።
questions.answer_en: When your child can show what he wants with a picture or sign, his frustration drops. Every time he signs, say the word out loud: "water." Many children later start saying the word themselves.
questions.next_step: Lesson 4.2 ቃል ለማይጠቀም ልጅ፦ ምልክትና ሥዕል

questions.q_am: ቃላትን ደጋግሞ ይላል፤ ከቴሌቪዥን የሰማውን ይደግማል።
questions.q_en: He repeats words, and repeats what he heard on TV.
questions.short_am: መጥፎ አይደለም፤ የመናገር አንድ ደረጃ ነው።
questions.short_en: It's not bad; it's one step towards talking.
questions.answer_am: ቃላትን መደጋገም ብዙ ልጆች ቋንቋ የሚማሩበት መንገድ ነው። አንዳንዴ «ደክሞኛል» ወይም «ደስ ብሎኛል» ማለት ነው። አያስቁሙት። የሚደግመውን ከሁኔታው ጋር ያገናኙ፤ ትክክለኛውን አጭር ቃል ይስጡት።
questions.answer_en: Repeating words is how many children learn language. Sometimes it means "I'm tired" or "I'm happy." Don't stop him. Connect what he repeats to the moment, and give him the right short word.
questions.next_step: Lesson 4.6 ቃላትን መደጋገምና ሌሎች የንግግር ልማዶች

questions.q_en: He has lost words he used to say.
questions.short_am: ይህ ቶሎ ለባለሙያ መንገር ያለብዎት ምልክት ነው።
questions.short_en: This is a sign to tell a professional soon.
questions.answer_am: አንዳንድ ልጆች ከ15 ወር እስከ 2 ዓመት አካባቢ ቃላት ይጠፉባቸዋል። ይህ የተለመደ የኦቲዝም ምልክት ነው፤ ግን ሌሎች ምክንያቶችም ስላሉ ባለሙያ ማየት አለበት። መቼ እንደጠፋ፣ ምን ቃላት እንደነበሩ ይጻፉ። እስከዚያው ማውራትና መጫወትዎን ይቀጥሉ።
questions.answer_en: Some children lose words around 15 months to 2 years. This is a known sign of autism, but there are other causes too, so a professional should check. Write down when it happened and which words he had. Meanwhile keep talking and playing.
questions.next_step: Signs checklist (5.3) · Find help (5.1)

questions.q_am: ስሙን ስጠራው አይዞርም። አይሰማም ማለት ነው?
questions.q_en: He doesn't turn when I call his name. Does it mean he can't hear?
questions.short_am: የመስማት ምርመራ ያስፈልጋል፤ ከዚያ ብቻ ይታወቃል።
questions.short_en: A hearing test is needed; only then will you know.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ ኦቲዝም ያለባቸው ልጆች በደንብ ይሰማሉ፤ ግን ለስማቸው ትኩረት አይሰጡም። አንዳንድ ልጆች ደግሞ የመስማት ችግር አለባቸው። ስለዚህ የመስማት ምርመራ ሁልጊዜ የመጀመሪያው እርምጃ ነው። ሐኪሙን «የመስማት ምርመራ ያስፈልገዋል?» ብለው ይጠይቁ።
questions.answer_en: Many children with autism hear well but don't pay attention to their name. Some children do have hearing loss. So a hearing test is always a first step. Ask the doctor "Does he need a hearing test?"
questions.next_step: What to ask the doctor (5.5)

questions.q_en: If we speak two languages to him, will he get confused?
questions.short_am: አይጋባም። በቤት የሚናገሩትን ቋንቋ ይጠቀሙ።
questions.short_en: No. Use the language you speak at home.
questions.answer_am: ጥናቶች ሁለት ቋንቋ ኦቲዝም ያለባቸውን ልጆች እንደማያዘገይ ያሳያሉ። ዋናው ነገር እርስዎ በቀላሉና በፍቅር የሚናገሩበት ቋንቋ ነው። እንግሊዝኛ ብቻ እንዲማር ብለው የቤቱን ቋንቋ ማቆም አያስፈልግም።
questions.answer_en: Studies show two languages do not slow down children with autism. What matters is the language you speak easily and warmly. You don't need to stop your home language so he learns only English.
questions.next_step: Lesson 4.1 መግባባት ከቃል ይበልጣል

questions.q_en: Have the phone and TV delayed his speech?
questions.short_am: ኦቲዝምን አያመጡም፤ ግን ብዙ ስክሪን የመነጋገሪያ ጊዜን ይወስዳል።
questions.short_en: They don't cause autism, but a lot of screen time takes away talking time.
questions.answer_am: ልጆች ቋንቋን የሚማሩት ከሰዎች ጋር በመነጋገርና በመጫወት ነው። የስክሪን ጊዜን ቀስ በቀስ ይቀንሱ፤ በምትኩ አብረው ይጫወቱ። ሲመለከት አብረው ይቀመጡ፣ ስለሚያየው ይናገሩ። በድንገት ሙሉ በሙሉ ማቆም ብዙ ቁጣ ሊያመጣ ይችላል።
questions.answer_en: Children learn language by talking and playing with people. Reduce screen time slowly and play together instead. When he watches, sit with him and talk about what he sees. Stopping it all suddenly can bring a lot of meltdowns.
questions.next_step: Lesson 4.3 ልጅዎ እንዲጠይቅ ዕድል መፍጠር · FAQ D8

questions.q_en: What should we do during a meltdown?
questions.short_am: ደህንነቱን ይጠብቁ፣ ይረጋጉ፣ ጥቂት ቃላት ብቻ።
questions.short_en: Keep him safe, stay calm, use few words.
questions.answer_am: በብስጭት ጊዜ ልጅዎ መማር ወይም ማዳመጥ አይችልም። መጀመሪያ እርስዎ ይተንፍሱ። አደገኛ ነገሮችን ያርቁ፣ ጫጫታውን ይቀንሱ፣ አጠገቡ ይቆዩ። «እዚህ ነኝ» ብቻ ይበሉ። አይምቱ፣ አያስፈራሩ። ሲረጋጋ ውሃ ይስጡትና ያመስግኑት። ምክንያቱን በኋላ ይፈልጉ።
questions.answer_en: During a meltdown your child cannot learn or listen. First, breathe yourself. Move dangerous things away, lower the noise, stay near. Say only "I'm here." Don't hit or threaten. When he is calm, give water and praise him. Look for the cause later.
questions.next_step: Right now: Angry, screaming (3.3) · Course 5 ቁጣና ከፍተኛ ማልቀስ

questions.q_en: He has meltdowns every day. When will it stop?
questions.short_am: ምክንያቱን ሲያገኙ ብዙ ጊዜ ይቀንሳል።
questions.short_en: When you find the cause, it usually goes down.
questions.answer_am: ቁጣ መልዕክት ነው፦ ርቦኛል፣ ደክሞኛል፣ ጫጫታው በዛብኝ፣ ለውጡን አልወደድኩትም። ለአንድ ሳምንት ከእያንዳንዱ ቁጣ በፊት ምን እንደሆነ ይጻፉ። ብዙ ጊዜ ተመሳሳይ ምክንያት ይታያል። ያንን ቀድመው ሲከላከሉ ቁጣው ይቀንሳል። በ«ልጄ» ገጽ ላይ ቁጣዎች በሳምንት ሲቀንሱ ያያሉ።
questions.answer_en: A meltdown is a message: I'm hungry, I'm tired, the noise is too much, I didn't like the change. For one week, write down what happened before each one. The same cause often shows up. When you prevent that, meltdowns go down. On "My child" you will see meltdowns per week fall.
questions.next_step: Lesson 5.1 ቁጣ ምን ይነግረናል? · Lesson 5.2 ቀድሞ መከላከል

questions.q_en: Is it better to give him what he wants when he cries?
questions.short_am: ለማስቆም ብቻ ብለው አይስጡ።
questions.short_en: Don't give it only to stop the crying.
questions.answer_am: ለቅሶ ሲያቆም ቢሰጡት፣ ልጅዎ «ማልቀስ ይሰራል» ብሎ ይማራል፤ ለቅሶውም ይበዛል። ይልቁንስ ተረጋግተው ይጠብቁ፣ ስሜቱን ይሰይሙ፣ ሲረጋጋ ወይም በምልክት ሲጠይቅ ይስጡት። ይህ ከባድ ነው፤ በተለይ ሰው ፊት። ቤተሰቡ በሙሉ አንድ ዓይነት እንዲያደርጉ ይነጋገሩ።
questions.answer_en: If you give it when he cries, your child learns "crying works," and crying grows. Instead, wait calmly, name his feeling, and give it when he is calm or asks with a sign. This is hard, especially in public. Agree as a family to all do the same.
questions.next_step: Right now: Cries when told no (3.3) · Lesson 9.3 ለቅሶ ሲመጣ

questions.q_am: ጆሮውን ይይዛል፤ ጫጫታና አዲስ ቦታ ያስፈራዋል።
questions.q_en: He covers his ears; noise and new places scare him.
questions.short_am: ለእሱ ድምፁ በእርግጥ በጣም ይበዛል።
questions.short_en: The sound really is too much for him.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ ኦቲዝም ያለባቸው ልጆች ድምፅ፣ ብርሃንና ንክኪን ከእኛ በበለጠ ይሰማቸዋል። ጆሮውን እንዲሸፍን ይፍቀዱለት፤ የጆሮ መሸፈኛ ይረዳል። ወደ አዲስ ቦታ ከመሄዳችሁ በፊት ፎቶ ያሳዩት፣ በጸጥታ ሰዓት ይሂዱ፣ ቆይታውን ያሳጥሩ፤ የሚያርፍበት ጥግም ያዘጋጁ።
questions.answer_en: Many children with autism feel sound, light and touch more strongly than we do. Let him cover his ears; ear defenders help. Before going somewhere new, show him a photo, go at a quiet time, keep the visit short, and find a corner where he can rest.
questions.next_step: Right now: Upset by noise or change (3.3) · Lesson 7.3 ሰው ፊት መውጣት

questions.q_am: ራሱን ይመታል፣ ጭንቅላቱን ግድግዳ ላይ ያጋጫል።
questions.q_en: He hits himself and bangs his head on the wall.
questions.short_am: ደህንነቱን ይጠብቁና ሐኪም ያማክሩ፤ ህመም ሊሆን ይችላል።
questions.short_en: Keep him safe and see a doctor; it may be pain.
questions.answer_am: ራስን መጉዳት ብዙ ጊዜ ህመም፣ ብስጭት ወይም ፍላጎቱን መናገር አለመቻል ያሳያል። በወቅቱ ጭንቅላቱን በትራስ ይጠብቁ፣ አደገኛ ነገሮችን ያርቁ፣ በኃይል አይያዙት። ሐኪም ጆሮ፣ ጥርስና ሆድ እንዲመረምር ይጠይቁ። ከቀጠለ ባለሙያ የባህሪ ዕቅድ ሊያዘጋጅ ይችላል። ደም ከፈሰሰ ወይም ራሱን ከሳተ 907 ይደውሉ።
questions.answer_en: Self-injury often shows pain, frustration or not being able to say what he needs. In the moment, protect his head with a pillow, move dangerous things, don't hold him down hard. Ask a doctor to check ears, teeth and stomach. If it continues, a professional can make a behaviour plan. If he bleeds or loses consciousness, call 907.
questions.next_step: Safety (3.5) · Lesson 5.5 ራሱን ሲጎዳ · Find help (5.1)

questions.q_en: He hits or bites other children.
questions.short_am: ሌሎችን ይጠብቁ፣ ከዚያ ሌላ መንገድ ያስተምሩት።
questions.short_en: Protect others, then teach him another way.
questions.answer_am: ልጅዎ «ተወኝ»፣ «የእኔ ነው» ወይም «በዛብኝ» ለማለት ቃል ስለሌለው ሊመታ ይችላል። በአጭሩ «መምታት አይሆንም» ይበሉ፣ ልጆቹን ይለያዩ። ከዚያ ያንን የሚናገርበት ምልክት ያስተምሩት። ከመምታቱ በፊት ምን እንደሚሆን ይመልከቱ፤ ብዙ ጊዜ ሊከለከል ይችላል።
questions.answer_en: Your child may hit because he has no words for "leave me," "it's mine" or "too much." Say briefly "No hitting" and separate the children. Then teach him a sign to say that. Watch what happens just before; it can often be prevented.
questions.next_step: Right now: Hitting or biting (3.3) · Lesson 4.2

questions.q_en: He slips out of the house; we're afraid he'll get lost.
questions.short_am: ቤቱን ያዘጋጁ፣ ስልክ ቁጥር ያድርጉለት፣ ጎረቤቶችን ያሳውቁ።
questions.short_en: Prepare the house, give him your number, tell the neighbours.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ ኦቲዝም ያለባቸው ልጆች ይሮጣሉ ወይም ሾልከው ይወጣሉ፤ ውሃና መንገድ ይስባቸዋል። ከፍ ያለ መቆለፊያ ያድርጉ፣ ስልክ ቁጥርዎን በኪሱ ወይም በአምባር ያድርጉ፣ የቅርብ ጊዜ ፎቶ ይያዙ፣ ጎረቤቶች ልጁን እንዲያውቁት ያድርጉ። ከጠፋ ውሃና መንገድ መጀመሪያ ይፈልጉ፤ ከ15 ደቂቃ በላይ ከሆነ 991 ይደውሉ።
questions.answer_en: Many children with autism run or slip out; water and roads attract them. Fit a high lock, put your number in his pocket or on a bracelet, keep a recent photo, and help neighbours know him. If he is lost, search water and roads first; after 15 minutes call 991.
questions.next_step: Safety (3.5) · Lesson 6.5 ደህንነት በቤትና ከቤት መጥፋት

questions.q_en: He gets angry when we take the phone. What do we do?
questions.short_am: አስቀድመው ያስጠንቅቁ፣ ቀጣዩን ያሳዩ፣ ቀስ በቀስ ይቀንሱ።
questions.short_en: Warn ahead, show what's next, reduce slowly.
questions.answer_am: ከሚወደው ነገር መለየት ለልጅዎ በጣም ከባድ ነው። «2 ደቂቃ ቀረ» ብለው ይንገሩት፣ የሰዓት ቆጣሪ ይጠቀሙ። «መጀመሪያ ስልክ፣ ከዚያ ኳስ» ብለው ቀጣዩን ያሳዩ። የስክሪን ጊዜ በቀን በተመሳሳይ ሰዓት ያድርጉ። ሲቆጣ መልሰው አይስጡት።
questions.answer_en: Leaving something he loves is very hard for your child. Tell him "2 minutes left" and use a timer. Show what's next: "First phone, then ball." Keep screen time at the same time each day. Don't give it back when he gets angry.
questions.next_step: Right now: Won't stop or move on (3.3) · Lesson 4.5

questions.q_en: My child won't sleep at night. What should I do?
questions.short_am: በየማታው አንድ ዓይነት የመኝታ ልማድ ይጀምሩ።
questions.short_en: Start the same bedtime routine every night.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ ኦቲዝም ያለባቸው ልጆች የእንቅልፍ ችግር አለባቸው። ከመተኛቱ 1 ሰዓት በፊት ስክሪን ያጥፉ። ተመሳሳይ ቅደም ተከተል ይከተሉ፦ መጸዳጃ፣ ልብስ፣ ውሃ፣ መዝሙር። መብራቱን ይቀንሱ። ጠዋት በአንድ ሰዓት ይቀስቅሱት፣ ቀን ላይ ረጅም እንቅልፍ አያስተኙት። ከሁለት ሳምንት በኋላ ለውጥ ማየት ይጀምራሉ።
questions.answer_en: Many children with autism have sleep problems. Turn screens off 1 hour before bed. Follow the same order: toilet, clothes, water, a song. Dim the lights. Wake him at the same time each morning and avoid long day naps. You often start to see change after about two weeks.
questions.next_step: Lesson 6.1 የመኝታ ልማድ · Right now: Won't sleep (3.3)

questions.q_en: He wakes up in the night and won't go back to sleep.
questions.short_am: በአጭሩ፣ በተመሳሳይ ቃልና ያለ መብራት ይመልሱት።
questions.short_en: Take him back briefly, with the same words and no lights.
questions.answer_am: ሲነቃ መብራት አያብሩ፣ ስክሪን ወይም ምግብ አይስጡ። «የእንቅልፍ ጊዜ ነው» ብለው ወደ አልጋው ይመልሱት፤ በጸጥታ አጠገቡ ይቆዩ። በየሌሊቱ ተመሳሳይ ያድርጉ። ብዙ ጊዜ ከተነሳ ህመም (ጆሮ፣ ጥርስ፣ የሆድ ድርቀት) ሊሆን ስለሚችል ሐኪም ያማክሩ።
questions.answer_en: When he wakes, don't turn on lights or give screens or food. Say "It's sleep time" and take him back to bed; stay quietly near him. Do the same every night. If he wakes a lot, it may be pain (ear, teeth, constipation), so see a doctor.
questions.next_step: Lesson 6.2 ማታ ሲነቃ

questions.q_en: Is sleep medicine safe?
questions.short_am: በሐኪም ትዕዛዝ ብቻ፤ ልማዱ መጀመሪያ ይሞከር።
questions.short_en: Only on a doctor's advice; try the routine first.
questions.answer_am: ለአዋቂዎች የሚሰጡ የእንቅልፍ ወይም የአለርጂ መድኃኒቶችን ለልጅ አይስጡ፤ አደገኛ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ። ሐኪሞች አንዳንዴ ለኦቲዝም ልጆች ሜላቶኒን ያዝዛሉ፤ ይህም ከመኝታ ልማድ ጋር ነው የሚሰራው። ልማዱን ለ2 ሳምንታት ከሞከሩ በኋላ ካልተሻሻለ ሐኪም ያማክሩ።
questions.answer_en: Don't give a child adult sleep or allergy medicine; it can be dangerous. Doctors sometimes prescribe melatonin for children with autism, and it works together with a bedtime routine. If the routine hasn't helped after 2 weeks, see a doctor.
questions.next_step: Lesson 8.3 መድኃኒትና ሐኪም · What to ask the doctor (5.5)

questions.q_am: ልጄ ምግብ በጣም ይመርጣል፤ ሩዝና ዳቦ ብቻ ነው የሚበላው።
questions.q_en: My child is very picky; he only eats rice and bread.
questions.short_am: የተለመደ ነው፤ ያለ ግፊት በትንሹ አዲስ ምግብ ያቅርቡ።
questions.short_en: It's common; offer new food in tiny amounts, without pressure.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ ልጆች ምግብን በቀለም፣ በሽታና በስሜት ይመርጣሉ። እንዲበላ አያስገድዱት። በሚወደው ምግብ አጠገብ አንድ ማንኪያ አዲስ ምግብ ያስቀምጡ፤ መንካት ወይም ማሽተት ብቻ ቢሆንም ይበቃል። አንድ ምግብ ከመቀበሉ በፊት 10 ወይም 15 ጊዜ ማየት ሊያስፈልገው ይችላል። ክብደቱ ከቀነሰ ሐኪም ያማክሩ።
questions.answer_en: Many children choose food by colour, smell and texture. Don't force him. Put one spoon of a new food beside his favourite; just touching or smelling it is enough. He may need to see a food 10 or 15 times before accepting it. If he loses weight, see a doctor.
questions.next_step: Lesson 6.3 ጥቂት ምግብ ብቻ ሲበላ

questions.q_am: ህመሙን መናገር አይችልም። ሲታመም እንዴት አውቃለሁ?
questions.q_en: He can't say he's in pain. How do I know when he's ill?
questions.short_am: የባህሪ ለውጥን ይከታተሉ።
questions.short_en: Watch for changes in behaviour.
questions.answer_am: ልጅዎ ህመሙን በባህሪ ያሳያል፦ ጆሮ መያዝ፣ ጭንቅላት መምታት፣ ሆዱን መያዝ፣ አለመብላት፣ ከወትሮው የበለጠ ቁጣ ወይም እንቅልፍ ማጣት። የሰውነት ሥዕል አሳይተው «የት?» ብለው ይጠይቁ። ትኩሳት፣ ማስመለስ ወይም ከባድ ህመም ካለ ወደ ጤና ተቋም ይሂዱ።
questions.answer_en: Your child shows pain through behaviour: holding his ears, hitting his head, holding his stomach, not eating, more meltdowns or less sleep than usual. Show a body picture and ask "where?" With fever, vomiting or severe pain, go to a health facility.
questions.next_step: Right now: Seems in pain (3.3) · Lesson 8.3

questions.q_am: ጸጉር ማስቆረጥና ገላ መታጠብ ጦርነት ነው።
questions.q_en: Haircuts and baths are a battle.
questions.short_am: አስቀድመው ያዘጋጁት፣ አጭር ያድርጉት፣ ቀለል ያሉ መሳሪያዎችን ይጠቀሙ።
questions.short_en: Prepare him, keep it short, use gentler tools.
questions.answer_am: የመቀስ ድምፅና ቀዝቃዛ ውሃ ለአንዳንድ ልጆች ህመም ይመስላቸዋል። ጸጉር ቤቱን አስቀድመው ይጎብኙ፣ በጸጥታ ሰዓት ይሂዱ፣ በእጅ የሚሰራ መቀስ ይጠይቁ። ለብ ያለ ውሃ በኩባያ ቀስ ብለው ያፍስሱ፣ ፊቱ ላይ አያፍስሱ። «እስከ 10» ቆጥረው ይጨርሱ፣ ከዚያ የሚወደውን ይስጡት።
questions.answer_en: The sound of clippers and cold water can feel painful to some children. Visit the barber first, go at a quiet time, ask for hand scissors. Pour lukewarm water slowly from a cup, never on his face. Count to 10 and finish, then give him something he loves.
questions.next_step: Right now: Refuses bath or haircut (3.3)

questions.q_am: ስንት ዓመቱ ሲሆን መጸዳጃ መጠቀም ይማራል?
questions.q_en: At what age will he learn to use the toilet?
questions.short_am: ከሌሎች ልጆች ሊዘገይ ይችላል፤ ግን ብዙ ልጆች ይማራሉ።
questions.short_en: It may come later than for other children, but most learn.
questions.answer_am: ምልክቶቹን ይጠብቁ፦ ለ1 ወይም 2 ሰዓት ደረቅ መቆየት፣ እርጥብ ሲሆን መናደድ። ከምግብ በኋላ በተመሳሳይ ሰዓት ይውሰዱት፣ ደረጃዎቹን በሥዕል ያሳዩ፣ ሲሳካ ያመስግኑት። አደጋ ሲደርስ አይቆጡ። የሆድ ድርቀት ካለ መጀመሪያ ሐኪም ያማክሩ።
questions.answer_en: Look for readiness: staying dry for 1 or 2 hours, getting upset when wet. Take him at the same times after meals, show the steps in pictures, praise success. Don't get angry at accidents. If he is constipated, see a doctor first.
questions.next_step: Lesson 6.4 የመጸዳጃ ስልጠና

questions.q_en: Can he go to school?
questions.short_am: ይችላል፤ ትክክለኛውን ቦታ መፈለግ ያስፈልጋል።
questions.short_en: Yes; the work is finding the right place.
questions.answer_am: ኢትዮጵያ ሁሉን አቀፍ ትምህርት ፖሊሲ አላት፤ ልጅዎ የመማር መብት አለው። አንዳንድ የመንግስት ትምህርት ቤቶች የልዩ ፍላጎት ክፍል አላቸው፣ ጥቂት የግል ትምህርት ቤቶችና ማዕከላትም ይቀበላሉ። ቦታዎቹ ጥቂት ስለሆኑ ቶሎ ይጠይቁ። «እርዳታ» ገጽ ላይ «ልዩ ፍላጎት የሚቀበሉ ት/ቤቶች» ይመልከቱ።
questions.answer_en: Ethiopia has an inclusive education policy; your child has the right to learn. Some government schools have special needs classes, and a few private schools and centers accept children too. Places are few, so ask early. See "Schools that accept special needs" on the Help page.
questions.next_step: Find help (5.1), filter "ት/ቤቶች"

questions.q_en: The school refused to take him.
questions.short_am: ተስፋ አይቁረጡ፤ ማዕከልዎና ሌሎች ትምህርት ቤቶች ሊረዱ ይችላሉ።
questions.short_en: Don't give up; your center and other schools may help.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ ቤተሰቦች ይህ ይደርስባቸዋል፤ በጣም ያማል። ርዕሰ መምህሩን ምን እንደሚያስፈልግ ይጠይቁ፤ አንዳንዴ የባለሙያ ደብዳቤ ወይም ረዳት መኖር በሩን ይከፍታል። ማዕከልዎ ከትምህርት ቤቱ ጋር እንዲነጋገር ይጠይቁ። የ«ለመምህራን» ኮርስን ለትምህርት ቤቱ ያጋሩ። በክፍለ ከተማው ትምህርት ጽ/ቤት ስለ ልዩ ፍላጎት ክፍሎች ይጠይቁ።
questions.answer_en: Many families face this, and it hurts. Ask the principal what is needed; sometimes a professional's letter or a helper opens the door. Ask your center to speak with the school. Share the "For teachers" course. Ask your sub-city education office about special needs classes.
questions.next_step: Course 10 ለመምህራን · Find help (5.1)

questions.q_en: What should I tell the teacher about my child?
questions.short_am: የሚወደውን፣ የሚያስጨንቀውን እና የሚያረጋጋውን።
questions.short_en: What he loves, what upsets him and what calms him.
questions.answer_am: አንድ ገጽ ያዘጋጁ፦ እንዴት እንደሚግባባ (ቃላት፣ ምልክቶች)፣ የሚወደው፣ የሚያስጨንቀው (ጫጫታ፣ ለውጥ)፣ የሚያረጋጋው፣ እና በብስጭት ጊዜ ምን ማድረግ እንዳለበት። ከመምህሩ ጋር በየሳምንቱ አጭር መልዕክት ይለዋወጡ።
questions.answer_en: Prepare one page: how he communicates (words, signs), what he loves, what upsets him (noise, change), what calms him, and what to do in a meltdown. Swap a short message with the teacher every week.
questions.next_step: Lesson 10.5 ከቤተሰብ ጋር መስራት · Share "For teachers" on Telegram

questions.q_am: ልዩ ትምህርት ቤት ይሻላል ወይስ መደበኛ?
questions.q_en: Is a special school better, or a regular one?
questions.short_am: እንደ ልጁ ይወሰናል፤ ባለሙያ ይረዳዎታል።
questions.short_en: It depends on the child; a professional can help you decide.
questions.answer_am: አንዳንድ ልጆች በመደበኛ ክፍል ከድጋፍ ጋር ጥሩ ይሰራሉ፣ ሌሎች መጀመሪያ በትንሽ ክፍል ወይም ማዕከል ይጠቀማሉ። ይጠይቁ፦ ክፍሉ ስንት ልጆች አሉት? መምህሩ ስልጠና አለው? ጸጥ ያለ ቦታ አለ? ከቤተሰብ ጋር ይሰራሉ? ውሳኔው ቋሚ አይደለም፤ ልጅዎ ሲያድግ ሊቀየር ይችላል።
questions.answer_en: Some children do well in a regular class with support; others benefit first from a small class or center. Ask: how many children in the class? Is the teacher trained? Is there a quiet space? Do they work with families? The decision isn't permanent; it can change as your child grows.
questions.next_step: Find help (5.1) · Course 10 ለመምህራን

questions.q_en: Other children laugh at him and tease him.
questions.short_am: ለመምህሩ ይንገሩ፤ ትምህርት ቤቱ የማስቆም ኃላፊነት አለበት።
questions.short_en: Tell the teacher; the school is responsible for stopping it.
questions.answer_am: ለልጅዎ «የአንተ ጥፋት አይደለም» ይንገሩት። ለመምህሩ የተፈጠረውን በዝርዝር ይንገሩ። መምህራን ለክፍሉ ልጆች ስለ ልዩነት ማስተማር ይችላሉ፤ ልጆች ሲረዱ ብዙ ጊዜ ይደግፋሉ። ልጅዎ ጓደኛ እንዲያገኝ በጋራ የሚወዱትን ጨዋታ ያበረታቱ።
questions.answer_en: Tell your child "it's not your fault." Tell the teacher exactly what happened. Teachers can teach the class about differences; when children understand, they often become supportive. Encourage a game he shares with others so he can make a friend.
questions.next_step: Lesson 10.5 · Lesson 7.1 መገለል ለምን ይጎዳል

questions.q_am: ማዕከሉ የወረፋ ዝርዝር ረጅም ነው። እስከዚያው ምን እናድርግ?
questions.q_en: The center's waiting list is long. What do we do meanwhile?
questions.short_am: በቤት ይጀምሩ፤ የሚሰሩት ሁሉ ይቆጠራል።
questions.short_en: Start at home; everything you do counts.
questions.answer_am: በብዙ ማዕከላት የሚጠብቁ ልጆች ከተመዘገቡት ይበዛሉ። በበርካታ ማዕከላት ይመዝገቡ፣ በየወሩ ይደውሉ። በWHO የተዘጋጀው የወላጅ ስልጠና በኢትዮጵያ ተሞክሯል፤ ወላጆች ቤት ውስጥ ብዙ ማድረግ እንደሚችሉ ያሳያል። የጋሻ ኮርሶች በዚህ ሀሳብ የተገነቡ ናቸው። በቀን 5 ደቂቃ ይጀምሩ።
questions.answer_en: At many centers, more children are waiting than enrolled. Register at several centers and call every month. WHO's caregiver skills training has been tried in Ethiopia and shows parents can do a lot at home. Gasha's courses are built on that idea. Start with 5 minutes a day.
questions.next_step: Course 3 ጨዋታና መቀራረብ · Find help (5.1)

questions.q_en: Will holy water or medicine cure him?
questions.short_am: ኦቲዝምን የሚያድን ነገር የለም፤ ግን ልጅዎ ብዙ ሊማርና ሊያድግ ይችላል።
questions.short_en: Nothing cures autism, but your child can learn and grow a lot.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ ቤተሰቦች ጸበል ይሄዳሉ፣ ይጸልያሉ፤ ይህ እምነትዎ ነው፣ መተው አያስፈልግዎትም። ጸሎት ለእርስዎ ጥንካሬ ሊሰጥ ይችላል። ልጁን ግን አይጉዱት፦ አለመመገብ፣ በብርድ ማቆየት፣ መምታት ወይም ማሰር አደገኛ ነው። «እርግጠኛ ፈውስ» ብለው ገንዘብ የሚጠይቁ ሰዎችን ይጠንቀቁ። ከጸሎቱ ጋር የቤት ልምምድና ቴራፒ ይቀጥሉ።
questions.answer_en: Many families go to holy water and pray; that is your faith and you don't have to give it up. Prayer can give you strength. But don't let your child be harmed: going without food, being kept in the cold, beaten or tied is dangerous. Be careful of people who ask for money for a "sure cure." Alongside prayer, keep up home practice and therapy.
questions.next_step: Course 8 ፈውስ፣ ጸበልና መድኃኒት · Lesson 1.4

questions.q_am: ልጁን ይዘን ቤተክርስቲያን ወይም መስጊድ መሄድ እንችላለን?
questions.q_en: Can we take him to church or mosque?
questions.short_am: ይችላሉ፤ ትንሽ ዝግጅት ይረዳል።
questions.short_en: Yes; a little preparation helps.
questions.answer_am: የአምልኮ ቦታ ለቤተሰቡ ሁሉ ነው። ጸጥ ባለ ሰዓት ይሂዱ፣ መጀመሪያ ለአጭር ጊዜ ይቆዩ፣ ከበሩ አጠገብ ይቀመጡ። የሚያረጋጋውን ነገር ይዘው ይሂዱ። ለካህኑ፣ ለሼኩ ወይም ለፓስተሩ ስለ ልጅዎ አስቀድመው ቢነግሩ ብዙ ጊዜ ይረዳሉ።
questions.answer_en: A place of worship is for the whole family. Go at a quiet time, stay briefly at first, sit near the door. Bring something that calms him. If you tell the priest, sheikh or pastor about your child beforehand, they often help.
questions.next_step: Lesson 7.3 ሰው ፊት መውጣት · Lesson 8.1

questions.q_en: My husband doesn't accept that our child has autism.
questions.short_am: ጊዜ ይወስዳል፤ በትንሹ ያሳትፉት።
questions.short_en: It takes time; involve him in small ways.
questions.answer_am: ብዙ አባቶች መጀመሪያ ይክዳሉ፣ ያዝናሉ ወይም ይርቃሉ። ይህ ሀዘን ነው፤ ፍቅር ማጣት አይደለም። ወደ ቀጠሮ እንዲመጣ ይጋብዙት። አንድ ትንሽ ስራ ይስጡት፦ ማታ 5 ደቂቃ መጫወት። የ«አባቶች» ትምህርትን ያጋሩት፣ በማዕከሉ የወላጆች ውይይት ላይ አብረው ይሂዱ።
questions.answer_en: Many fathers at first deny it, grieve or pull away. That is grief, not lack of love. Invite him to an appointment. Give him one small job: 5 minutes of play at night. Share the lesson for fathers, and go to a center parents' meeting together.
questions.next_step: Lesson 7.4 በቤተሰብ ውስጥ፦ ወቀሳ፣ አለመስማማትና አባቶች · Lesson 1.5

questions.q_en: What do we say when people stare and talk?
questions.short_am: አጭርና የተረጋጋ መልስ ያዘጋጁ።
questions.short_en: Prepare a short, calm answer.
questions.answer_am: በአዲስ አበባ ጥናት ከወላጆች ግማሽ ያህሉ እፍረት እንደሚሰማቸው ተናግረዋል። ይህ ስሜት የእርስዎ ጥፋት አይደለም። አጭር መልስ ይጠቀሙ፦ «ልጄ ኦቲዝም አለበት። ደህና ነን፣ እናመሰግናለን።» በጋሻ ውስጥ ያለውን ካርድ ማሳየትም ይችላሉ። ልጅዎን አይደብቁ፤ ሰዎች ሲያዩት ይለምዱታል።
questions.answer_en: In a study in Addis Ababa, about half of parents said they feel shame. That feeling is not your fault. Use a short answer: "My child has autism. We're fine, thank you." You can also show the card in Gasha. Don't hide your child; people get used to seeing him.
questions.next_step: Lesson 7.2 ለዘመድና ለጎረቤት ምን እንበል · Right now: In public (3.3)

questions.q_en: His brothers and sisters feel jealous.
questions.short_am: ለእነሱም ብቻቸውን ጊዜ ይስጡ።
questions.short_en: Give them time on their own too.
questions.answer_am: ወንድሞችና እህቶች ወላጆች ለኦቲዝም ልጁ ብዙ ጊዜ ስለሚሰጡ ሊቀኑ ወይም ሊያፍሩ ይችላሉ። በዕድሜያቸው መጠን ኦቲዝምን ያስረዷቸው። በቀን 10 ደቂቃ ብቻቸውን ይሁኑ። ሁልጊዜ እንዲሰጡ ወይም እንዲጠብቁት አያድርጓቸው።
questions.answer_en: Siblings may feel jealous or embarrassed because parents give the child with autism a lot of time. Explain autism at their level. Spend 10 minutes alone with each of them daily. Don't make them always give in or always look after him.
questions.next_step: Lesson 7.5 ወንድሞችና እህቶች · Lesson 3.5

questions.q_en: If we have another child, will he have autism too?
questions.short_am: ዕድሉ በትንሹ ከፍ ያለ ነው፤ ግን አብዛኞቹ ወንድሞችና እህቶች ኦቲዝም የላቸውም።
questions.short_en: The chance is somewhat higher, but most siblings do not have autism.
questions.answer_am: ኦቲዝም ያለበት ልጅ ያለው ቤተሰብ ለሚቀጥለው ልጅ ዕድሉ ከሌሎች ቤተሰቦች ከፍ ያለ ነው። ግን አብዛኞቹ ወንድሞችና እህቶች ኦቲዝም የላቸውም። ውሳኔው የእናንተ ነው። ቀጣዩ ልጅ ቢወለድ እድገቱን ቀድሞ ይከታተሉ፤ ምልክቶችን ቶሎ ያውቃሉ። ጥያቄ ካለዎት ሐኪም ያማክሩ።
questions.answer_en: In a family with one child with autism, the chance for the next child is higher than for other families. But most brothers and sisters do not have autism. The decision is yours. If another child comes, watch their development early; you will recognise signs quickly. Ask a doctor if you have questions.
questions.next_step: Signs checklist (5.3) · What to ask the doctor (5.5)

questions.q_am: ሲያድግ ራሱን ችሎ ይኖራል? ይሰራል? ያገባል?
questions.q_en: When he grows up, will he live on his own? Work? Marry?
questions.short_am: ብዙ ኦቲዝም ያለባቸው ሰዎች ይሰራሉ፣ ቤተሰብ ይመሰርታሉ፤ ለእያንዳንዱ የተለየ ነው።
questions.short_en: Many people with autism work and have families; it's different for each.
questions.answer_am: ዛሬ ማንም የልጅዎን የወደፊት ሕይወት ሊነግርዎ አይችልም። የሚታወቀው ድጋፍ ልዩነት እንደሚያመጣ ነው። የዕለት ክህሎቶችን ከአሁኑ ያስተምሩት፦ መልበስ፣ መብላት፣ ቀላል የቤት ስራ። ጠንካራ ጎኖቹን ይፈልጉ። አንዳንድ ማዕከላት ለትላልቅ ልጆች የሙያ ስልጠና ይሰጣሉ።
questions.answer_en: No one can tell you your child's future today. What we know is that support makes a difference. Teach daily skills now: dressing, eating, simple chores. Look for his strengths. Some centers offer vocational training for older children.
questions.next_step: Lesson 2.4 የልጅዎ ጠንካራ ጎኖችና የወደፊቱ ጊዜ · Find help (5.1)

questions.q_en: Will he get worse as he grows?
questions.short_am: ብዙ ጊዜ አይባባስም፤ ልጆች በድጋፍ ይሻሻላሉ።
questions.short_en: Usually not; children improve with support.
questions.answer_am: ኦቲዝም ዕድሜ ልክ ነው፤ ግን ልጁ በየዓመቱ ይማራል ያድጋል። አንዳንድ ጊዜያት (ጉርምስና፣ ለውጥ) ከባድ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ። ክህሎቶች ሲጠፉ፣ ቁጣ በድንገት ሲበዛ ወይም ዝምታ ሲበዛ ግን ህመም ወይም ሌላ ችግር ሊሆን ስለሚችል ባለሙያ ያማክሩ።
questions.answer_en: Autism is lifelong, but your child learns and grows every year. Some periods (puberty, big changes) can be harder. But if skills are lost, meltdowns suddenly increase or he becomes very withdrawn, it may be illness or another problem, so see a professional.
questions.next_step: My child: monthly check-in · Find help (5.1)

questions.q_en: Who will care for him when we are gone?
questions.short_am: ከአሁኑ ቤተሰብንና ማህበረሰብን ማዘጋጀት ይችላሉ።
questions.short_en: You can start preparing family and community now.
questions.answer_am: ይህ ብዙ ወላጆችን የሚያስጨንቅ ጥያቄ ነው። ከአሁኑ ሌሎችን ያሳትፉ፦ አያቶች፣ አክስቶች፣ ወንድሞችና እህቶች ልጁን እንዲያውቁትና እንዲንከባከቡት ያስተምሩ። የልጁን ፍላጎቶች፣ ልማዶችና የሚያረጋጉትን የሚገልጽ ማስታወሻ ይጻፉ። ከሌሎች ወላጆችና ከማዕከሉ ጋር ይገናኙ፤ በጋራ የወደፊት መፍትሄ ይፈልጋሉ።
questions.answer_en: This question worries many parents. Involve others now: teach grandparents, aunts, and brothers and sisters to know and care for him. Write a note describing his needs, routines and what calms him. Connect with other parents and the center; together you look for future solutions.
questions.next_step: Course 9 ለአያቶችና ለቤት ሰራተኞች · Center events (6.3)

questions.q_en: He is 8 now. Is it too late to help?
questions.short_am: አልዘገዩም። በማንኛውም ዕድሜ መማር ይቻላል።
questions.short_en: It's not too late. Learning happens at any age.
questions.answer_am: ቶሎ መጀመር ይረዳል፤ ግን ዘግይቶ መጀመር ዋጋ የለውም ማለት አይደለም። ትላልቅ ልጆችና ወጣቶችም አዲስ የመግባቢያ፣ የዕለት ኑሮና የማህበራዊ ክህሎቶች ይማራሉ። ዛሬ ካለበት ደረጃ ይጀምሩ።
questions.answer_en: Starting early helps, but starting later still matters. Older children and teenagers also learn new communication, daily living and social skills. Start from where he is today.
questions.next_step: Lesson 1.6 · Find help (5.1)
